About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.

You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.


What You’ll Do

Technical Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.

  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring requirements, interview strategies, talent profiles, and workforce planning priorities.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.

  • Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.

  • Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.

  • Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.

  • Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.

  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As Manager, Corporate Finance, you will own Imprint's financial planning and analysis function, with direct accountability for building the systems, models, and processes that power forward-looking financial decision-making.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who builds with code as naturally as they build with spreadsheets — and who is energized by replacing manual workflows with automated, scalable infrastructure. You will partner directly with the Deputy CFO and work cross-functionally with Commercial, Accounting, Treasury, Data and Engineering teams to bring rigor and speed to how Imprint forecasts, plans, and operates financially.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and has strong opinions about how modern finance teams should operate.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Migrated major models from Excel to Python, with outputs in Excel or a web-based application, enabling faster iteration and significantly improved accuracy

  • Automated key commentary and data pulls, eliminating manual reporting workflows through Google Sheets, a web application, or equivalent tooling

  • Established a foundation for forward-looking forecasting (3–6 month outlook), including early governance and process structures

  • Built trusted working relationships with Commercial, Finance, Data, and Engineering teams

  • Demonstrated the ability to operate independently and iterate quickly on high-priority workstreams

Responsibilities

  • Own the design, build, and maintenance of Imprint's corporate financial model, transitioning it from Excel to Python-based infrastructure

  • Automate financial reporting and commentary workflows to reduce manual data pulling and accelerate insights delivery

  • Build and maintain forward-looking forecasts (3–6 month horizon) that give the business clear financial visibility

  • Partner with Commercial GMs and partner leads to incorporate revenue and cost inputs into planning models

  • Collaborate with Accounting on book close, cost pipeline, and reporting accuracy

  • Work with Treasury and Vendor Management on cash flow and cost forecasting

  • Support headcount planning and its impact on financial forecasts in partnership with the People team

  • Use AI tooling (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to build scalable, automated finance workflows

  • Identify and eliminate inefficiencies in how financial data is collected, modeled, and reported

  • Present financial insights clearly to senior stakeholders, translating complex outputs into actionable decisions

Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on, working knowledge of Python — must have built models, scripts, or automated tools, not just theoretical familiarity

  • Demonstrated experience building with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, or similar) — this is a non-negotiable

  • Background in financial planning, corporate finance, or an adjacent analytical domain

  • Ability to operate with minimal direction and iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a startup mindset — willing to fail fast, course correct, and move forward

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work effectively with Commercial, Accounting, Treasury, and People teams

  • 5–10 years of experience in a finance, data, or analytically intensive role

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or a product-led company

  • Familiarity with building web-based applications or data pipelines

  • Experience in a high-growth or early-stage company environment

  • Prior exposure to corporate modeling, forecasting, or FP&A processes

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

Description

Data Privacy Law Attorney

Senior Associate | Counsel | Partner

Remote | United States | Full-Time or Part-Time

About the Opportunity

We are supporting a growing U.S. law firm in the search for an experienced Data Privacy Law Attorney to join its fully remote legal team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with strong experience in U.S. privacy law, transactional matters, commercial contracts, and client counseling, particularly someone who enjoys working directly with sophisticated business and legal teams.

The role may be structured as Senior Associate, Counsel, or Partner, depending on the candidate's experience and level of expertise.

Key Responsibilities

The attorney will advise enterprise clients on a broad range of privacy and transactional matters, including:

  • U.S. federal and state privacy laws.
  • CCPA/CPRA and emerging state comprehensive privacy laws.
  • Data privacy requirements for websites, applications, products, and services.
  • Privacy issues involving marketing, advertising technology, cookies, tracking, and digital platforms.
  • Data collection, use, sharing, retention, and disclosure.
  • Vendor and third-party privacy matters.
  • Privacy-by-design considerations.
  • International data transfers and related requirements.
  • Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
  • Privacy policies, privacy notices, and terms of use.
  • Technology and commercial agreements.
  • Data-security and confidentiality provisions.
  • Indemnification, limitation of liability, warranties, insurance, and other risk-allocation provisions.
  • Privacy compliance programs, data mapping, audits, and governance.
  • Data-security incidents and incident-response planning.

The attorney will also have the opportunity to work closely with business, technology, security, marketing, and legal teams to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice.

Requirements

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience specifically practicing Data Privacy Law.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. privacy and data-security laws.
  • Hands-on experience with CCPA/CPRA and U.S. state privacy laws.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating DPAs, privacy provisions, and commercial agreements.
  • Strong transactional and contract-negotiation experience.
  • Excellent client counseling and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage complex matters independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality of work product.
  • Strong judgment, ownership, and follow-through.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior business and legal stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring, training, or leading other attorneys is highly valued.
  • Graduate of a Top 60 U.S. law school OR graduated in the top 20% of the law school class.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Enterprise or in-house legal experience.
  • Experience working as a seconded or embedded legal resource.
  • Experience advising consumer-facing brands.
  • Privacy experience involving marketing and advertising technology.
  • Technology transactions experience.
  • SaaS and/or MarTech experience.
  • CIPP/US or CIPP/E certification.
  • GDPR and international privacy experience.
  • Data-security incident response experience.
  • Experience developing or managing corporate privacy programs.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the United States.
  • Full-time or part-time flexibility.
  • Approximately 15–40 hours per week, depending on the attorney's preferred workload.
  • Flexible annual billable-hour expectations of approximately 700–1,410 hours.
  • Significant autonomy over your schedule.
  • Sophisticated legal work with enterprise clients.
  • Opportunity to act as an outside General Counsel and trusted business advisor.
  • Collaborative team of experienced attorneys.
  • Opportunities for leadership and practice development.
  • Secondment and overflow transactional opportunities.
  • Paid vacation.
  • Unlimited sick leave.
  • Sabbatical and additional unpaid vacation options.
  • Partial health insurance reimbursement.
  • 401(k) with up to 4% employer match.
  • Practical Law and Westlaw access.
  • Annual bar dues reimbursement.

Why This Opportunity?

This role is designed for an attorney who wants to combine high-level privacy and transactional work with meaningful flexibility and autonomy.

The ideal candidate is not only technically strong, but also able to understand the client's business, communicate complex legal issues clearly, and develop practical solutions.

Requirements

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience specifically practicing Data Privacy Law.
  2. Active U.S. bar license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  3. Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy and data protection laws, including CCPA/CPRA.
  4. Hands-on experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and privacy/data security provisions.
  5. Experience with commercial and transactional agreements, including technology, SaaS, vendor, and other business contracts.
  6. Proven experience advising clients on data privacy, technology, marketing, and commercial matters.
  7. Knowledge of marketing privacy, cookies, tracking technologies, AdTech, CRM, analytics, and consumer data practices.
  8. Experience developing or managing privacy programs, including data mapping, compliance assessments, policies, procedures, and vendor risk management.
  9. Ability to manage complex legal matters independently, communicate directly with sophisticated clients, and collaborate with executive, technology, security, and business teams.
  10. Education: Graduate of a Top 60 U.S. Law School or ranked within the Top 20% of the graduating class.

Role Title: Postal Clerk

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Time Commitment: 15-25 hours/week, short-term project

micro1 is looking for Postal Clerks to help evaluate and improve AI systems on postal service topics. You’ll use your front-counter experience to check that questions sound like real customers and that answers are correct and useful. Accuracy comes first. No AI experience is needed; your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review sample postal questions and flag any that don’t sound like what real customers ask.
  2. Write rubrics that define a correct, complete answer on mail classes, shipping options, postage, fees, and shipping labels.
  3. Cover package tracking, missing or damaged mail, change of address and mail forwarding, and international mailing and customs forms in your rubrics.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated answers against your rubrics, flagging errors, omissions, and outdated guidance.
  5. Share clear written feedback with the project team, working asynchronously.

Required Qualifications

  1. Current, former, or retired USPS frontline experience (postal clerk, sales and service associate, or retail associate)
  2. 1+ years helping customers in person at a post office counter
  3. Working knowledge of mail classes, shipping options, postage, tracking, and change of address
  4. US-based
  5. Able to start quickly and commit 15-25 hours/week
  6. Clear, precise writing

Not a fit: Mail carrier, mail processing, or private shipping store experience alone

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with international mail and customs documentation
  2. Experience handling missing or damaged mail claims
  3. Experience creating guides, FAQs, or training materials
  4. Experience helping a diverse range of customers, including rural and non-English-speaking communities

raw.description:
Have you ever had to make the tough call on what to build, what to buy, and what needs fixing now while keeping the business moving? If you know how to balance great engineering with commercial reality, bring teams together, and turn a messy technology estate into something that can scale, we have a system for you to shape.

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

For this position we will happily accept applicants from Portugal, Kenya or South Africa.

The Job

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology and Product Officer (CTPO), the Deputy Chief Technology Officer will take end-to-end operational and strategic ownership of roughly half our total tech organisation - leading 50 - 60 engineers, architects, and data professionals across four distinct teams. You will partner closely with your peer, the Deputy Chief Product Officer, to turn our technology vision into a resilient, scalable, and high-throughput reality.

This is not an advisory, fractional, or hands-off consulting role.

We are looking for an operational heavyweight who thrives in the weeds of engineering standards, architecture trade-offs, and ISO 27001 compliance, while building the conditions that make delivery predictable and sustainable. You will lead through directors, raise the bar for technical excellence, and serve as the ultimate arbitrator for build-vs-buy decisions across our platform, data, and infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture Strategy

  • Own the overarching integrity of Tiko's technical architecture, setting cross-cutting principles and standards across engineering, data, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Arbitrate major build-vs-buy decisions, evaluating long-term operational costs, reliability, and platform growth against immediate business priorities.
  • Contribute technical initiatives directly to the joint product and tech roadmap, ensuring foundational platform health and tech-debt management are prioritised alongside feature delivery.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry shifts to ensure Tiko's platform remains modern, secure, and fit for purpose across our operating regions.

Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop senior leaders—including two Engineering Directors, a Data Architect, and a Software & Infrastructure Architect.
  • Scale and nurture a high-performing 50+ person engineering organisation, fostering a culture grounded in psychological safety, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous learning.
  • Establish metrics, SLAs, and KPIs to track platform health, delivery performance, and engineering effectiveness, using data to drive continuous optimisation.
  • Own the organisational conditions for predictable, low-toil delivery, empowering your Engineering Directors to execute individual projects with autonomy and accountability.

Governance, Risk & Security

  • Champion security, privacy, and regulatory compliance across all engineering practices, keeping our ecosystem strictly aligned with ISO 27001 standards and strict data protection obligations.
  • Identify, monitor, and mitigate technical, operational, and vendor risks, maintaining tested continuity and disaster-recovery plans across our platform.
  • Serve as the primary engineering and architecture interface for executive leadership, effectively translating technical debt, risk, and architectural choices into business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, marketing, and MERL teams to break down silos and ensure seamless execution of company objectives.

About You

You are a grounded, low-ego technical leader who values organisational impact and real-world delivery far above corporate titles. You are energized by the systemic challenge of leading a multi-team engineering organisation through its next stage of scale. You combine deep, battle-tested software and data engineering fundamentals with the emotional intelligence needed to mentor directors, align cross-functional peers, and foster a growth-oriented, inclusive environment for girls and the communities we serve.

Requirements

  • Proven Scale Leadership: 8+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, with a track record of directly or indirectly managing multi-team organisations of 40+ people (managing through directors, not just individual contributors or frontline managers).
  • Full-Time Operational Ownership: Demonstrated history of full-time, hands-on operational leadership in scaling product-led tech environments (fractional, part-time, or pure advisory experience will not fit this requirement).
  • Architectural Mastery: Deep experience defining enterprise architecture standards, managing complex distributed systems, and leading data infrastructure transformations.
  • Security & Compliance: Direct experience driving compliance, security governance, and data privacy frameworks (specifically ISO 27001 and local data protection regulations).
  • Communication & Alignment: Exceptional verbal and written European English communication skills, with a proven ability to act as an internal and external technical evangelist.

Bonus Points (The Differentiators):

  • Hands-on experience scaling technology platforms across emerging markets or lower-bandwidth environments in Africa.
  • Deep background in data engineering, analytics architectures, or financial/incentive payout systems at scale.
  • Direct experience partnering with executive leadership in a matrixed, cross-functional global non-profit or social enterprise.

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Second Interview with Tech Team | Final interview with the Co-CEO

The Rewards

  • We offer a competitive salary based on experience, location and the agreed scope of the position
  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
  • A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko.

We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
  • Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures.
We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. We invite you to review our privacy notice for the recruitment process to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. Click here to view the document. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our privacy notice.

Job Title: Remote IT Technician

Location: USA (100% Remote)
Company: Everglade Works

About Everglade Works
We are Everglade Works an innovative IT solutions company known for solving complex technical challenges and keeping systems flowing like a dream. Our clients rely on us for smart, scalable tech support, and our people are the reason we deliver. We don't just hire techs we bring on technicians who think like engineers and support like pros.

What You'll Be Doing
You'll be the go-to IT expert remotely supporting our internal team and external clients across various systems. You'll troubleshoot like a champ, maintain systems like a pro, and explain complex tech in a way that even your grandma would get.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Provide top-tier remote technical support for hardware, software, and network issues

  • Install, configure, and maintain workstations, laptops, VPNs, and remote tools

  • ️ Troubleshoot system errors and outages like a detective on a mission

  • Set up and manage user accounts, permissions, and device configurations

  • Monitor and support cybersecurity tools, patch updates, and backups

  • Document resolutions, create internal knowledge base articles, and keep logs updated

  • Work closely with our Support Lead and other departments to solve issues and improve operations

  • Stay up to date on the latest IT trends and bring proactive solutions to the table

What We are Looking For
We are not just looking for someone who can reset passwords (although, yeah you'll do that too). We want someone who gets excited about solving problems and making tech work better for people.

  • 2+ years of experience as an IT Technician or similar role

  • Strong knowledge of Windows and MacOS environments

  • Comfortable with remote support tools (TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Remote Desktop, etc.)

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms like Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

  • Experience troubleshooting printers, VPNs, networking issues, and firewalls

  • Great communicator verbal and written (we love clarity!)

About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

About The Role

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of Chainlink products across the capital markets industry as we continue to expand our presence there.

You will work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to evangelise Chainlink technology across the finance industry and work directly with technical teams at major institutions to gather requirements, scope projects and deliver innovative solutions that address the complex needs of their stakeholders. You will also work directly with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Legal and make a significant contribution to the ongoing development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy.

  • Drive the successful adoption of Chainlink products in the capital markets industry by establishing strong relationships with key stakeholders, including major financial institutions, and providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the sales and implementation process

  • Lead and actively participate in gathering requirements, scoping projects, and designing innovative solutions that leverage Chainlink products to address specific use cases and challenges within the capital markets industry

  • Contribute significantly to the development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy by providing valuable insights, market feedback, and technical expertise, thereby influencing the direction and roadmap of the product suite

  • Collaborate closely with internal technical teams, including developers and engineers, to provide feedback and guidance on product enhancements, bug fixes, and new feature development, ensuring that the capital markets requirements are effectively addressed

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the capital markets industry, including market trends, challenges, and emerging technologies, to effectively position and promote Chainlink products

Requirements

  • Technical pre/postsales technology experience, working with major institutions within capital markets or payment

  • Experience with, and strong knowledge of blockchain technology and associated areas (e.g. DeFi, tokenisation / digital assets, digital identity, etc.)

  • Hands-on experience with middleware, integration architecture patterns, web services technologies, and APIs

  • Experience building and delivering Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and responding to functional and technical elements of proposals independently,

  • Respond independently and effectively to RFIs, RFPs, and Due Diligence Questionnaires (DDQs) — covering functional, technical, security, and compliance dimensions

  • Build and deliver bespoke Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and prototype integrations that demonstrate viability within the customer's existing technology stack

  • Contribute to and maintain a library of reference architectures, solution accelerators, and technical decision guides for use across the solutions team

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in any of the following: Solidity, Golang, Rust, JS, Java, Python, C/C++

  • Experience in networking protocols, private IP environments, cloud infrastructure, and the implementation of SSL/TLS security measures

  • Knowledge of capital markets concepts, financial instruments and trading processes, including Corporate actions, PMS, OMS, Exchanges, FMIs, Clearing houses, etc.

  • Experience with permissioned blockchain and public blockchains with familiarity with decentralised oracle design, data feed mechanisms, proof-of-reserve systems, or cross-chain messaging protocols

  • Prior involvement in Digital Assets design, tokenised collateral programs, or digital securities issuance platforms at a regulated financial institution or central bank

  • Experience as a technical author — published white papers, reference architectures, or standards contributions in blockchain, fintech, or capital markets

  • Certifications in AWS / Azure / GCP (Solutions Architect level or above), TOGAF, etc.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Role Summary

The Risk team at Imprint is responsible for making smarter, faster credit decisions that balance growth with responsible risk management. The team builds the models, policies, and analytical systems that power underwriting, fraud detection, and portfolio optimization across all of Imprint’s credit programs.

As a Data Scientist, Risk, you will own the modeling powering Imprint’s top-of-funnel credit decisioning—from application intake through approval—across every acquisition channel: direct affiliates (Credit Karma, NerdWallet), invitation-to-apply emails, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications. Your primary focus will be improving approval rates while maintaining credit quality: building better underwriting models, designing policy experiments, and uncovering segments where we can safely expand access to credit.

This role sits at the intersection of credit and acquisition strategy. You will partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to build targeting models for new channels, evaluate channel-level credit performance, and connect acquisition volume to downstream economics—approval rates, vintage loss forecasts, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit. Increasingly, that means building not just analyses but AI-powered systems that can autonomously monitor approval rate, channel performance, diagnose shifts, and recommend policy adjustments.

The Opportunity

About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

About the role
We’re looking for an RN who brings energy, warmth, and authenticity to every patient interaction—especially on video. In this role, you’ll connect with patients through daily video check-ins, offering encouragement, education, and accountability that helps them stay on track with their medications.

  • Enjoys building rapport quickly through virtual, asynchronous interactions
  • Can motivate and encourage patients in short, meaningful video touchpoints
  • Is passionate about making healthcare more personal, accessible, and supportive

As a Clinical Adherence Nurse (RN), you will play a key role in enrolling, engaging, and supporting patients in a high-impact medication adherence program designed to improve health outcomes. This innovative role uses asynchronous video communication and digital engagement to build meaningful patient relationships and deliver personalized clinical support.

Through daily video check-ins, you will connect with patients, offering encouragement, education, and accountability that helps them stay on track with their medications and care plans. Using your clinical expertise and motivational communication skills, you will guide patients through challenges, celebrate progress, and help them build sustainable health habits.

In this role, you will help patients overcome barriers related to social determinants of health, provide tailored education, and monitor medication-taking behavior through video-based interactions. By building trust through engaging video communication, you will inspire patients to actively participate in their care and empower them to take greater control of their health.

  • Provide referrals to healthcare providers and community resources when needed, including direct outreach to provider offices and/or warm transfers to service providers
  • Utilize motivational interviewing techniques within video and digital engagement to engage patients in long-term adherence strategies
  • Offer guidance on inhaler techniques, chronic disease management, and medication safety
  • Contribute to program improvement by providing insights from patient interactions, particularly regarding video engagement, digital adherence monitoring, and patient education strategies
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop and refine video-based patient engagement content, clinical protocols, and educational materials

  • Strong background in chronic disease management, medication adherence, and patient coaching
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with a warm, empathetic approach
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, patient-focused environment

  • Be part of an innovative healthcare solution addressing a $500B medication adherence challenge

  • Professional development and growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling company

The biggest perk is that you will be working on a game-changing solution in healthcare with people who are talented, motivated, and passionate. Scene has impacted thousands of lives to date, but you will be integral in scaling that impact.

If you are a compassionate, tech-savvy nurse with a passion for patient engagement and medication adherence, we want to hear from you! Apply today to join us in transforming healthcare and empowering patients toward better health outcomes.

**Candidates must reside in Puerto Rico and maintain Puerto Rico residency throughout employment. Must be legally authorized to work in Puerto Rico/United States without employer sponsorship; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We believe in reflecting the diversity of our customers and their patients in our team. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Scene is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental ability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Enfermero(a) Clínico(a) de Adherencia (RN) – Bilingüe (Inglés y Español)

Acerca de Scene Health

En Scene Health, nuestro modelo de atención integral 360° fortalece el estándar de excelencia en la adherencia a los medicamentos mediante la Terapia de Observación Directa (Directly Observed Therapy o DOT).

Combinamos acompañamiento personalizado por video, educación en salud y contenido motivacional para conectar a profesionales de la salud, pacientes y sus familias con el fin de enfrentar uno de los mayores desafíos del sistema de salud: el incumplimiento del tratamiento con medicamentos, un problema que representa un impacto estimado de $500 mil millones.

Nuestra aplicación móvil permite que los pacientes se mantengan conectados con un equipo de atención compuesto por farmacéuticos(as), enfermeros(as) y coaches de salud mediante seguimientos diarios por video, desde cualquier lugar y en cualquier momento.

En Scene, hacemos que el proceso de seguir el tratamiento sea más sencillo y motivador. Ayudamos a los pacientes a superar los desafíos relacionados con el uso de sus medicamentos y les brindamos las herramientas y el apoyo necesarios para mejorar su salud, abordando las barreras para la adherencia asociadas a los determinantes sociales de la salud.

⚠️ IMPORTANTE: ESTA OPORTUNIDAD DE EMPLEO ESTÁ DISPONIBLE ÚNICAMENTE PARA PERSONAS QUE SEAN RESIDENTES LEGALES DE PUERTO RICO.

Los candidatos deben residir en Puerto Rico al momento de solicitar y mantener su residencia en Puerto Rico durante toda su relación laboral. Además, deben estar legalmente autorizados para trabajar en Puerto Rico y en los Estados Unidos sin necesidad de patrocinio por parte del empleador. No se ofrece patrocinio de visa para esta posición.

¿A quién buscamos?

Buscamos un(a) Enfermero(a) Registrado(a) (RN) que transmita energía, calidez y autenticidad en cada interacción con los pacientes, especialmente a través de video.

En este puesto, se comunicará diariamente con los pacientes mediante seguimientos por video, brindándoles apoyo, educación y motivación para ayudarlos a mantenerse al día con sus medicamentos y su plan de tratamiento.

El candidato ideal:

  • Se siente cómodo(a) comunicándose frente a la cámara y proyecta confianza de manera natural.
  • Tiene facilidad para establecer una buena relación con los pacientes mediante interacciones virtuales y asincrónicas.
  • Sabe motivar e inspirar a los pacientes a través de mensajes breves y significativos en video.
  • Le apasiona hacer que la atención médica sea más humana, accesible y centrada en el paciente.

Descripción del Puesto

Como Enfermero(a) Clínico(a) de Adherencia (RN), desempeñará un papel fundamental en la inscripción, participación y acompañamiento de pacientes dentro de un programa de alto impacto enfocado en mejorar la adherencia a los medicamentos y los resultados de salud.

Este puesto innovador utiliza comunicación asincrónica por video y herramientas digitales para crear relaciones significativas con los pacientes y brindar apoyo clínico personalizado.

A través de seguimientos diarios por video, acompañará a los pacientes ofreciéndoles orientación, educación y responsabilidad para ayudarlos a cumplir con sus medicamentos y su plan de cuidado. Utilizando su experiencia clínica y excelentes destrezas de comunicación motivacional, ayudará a los pacientes a superar desafíos, reconocer sus logros y desarrollar hábitos saludables a largo plazo.

También apoyará a los pacientes a superar barreras relacionadas con los determinantes sociales de la salud, brindará educación personalizada y supervisará la adherencia al tratamiento mediante interacciones por video. Al generar confianza a través de una comunicación cercana y efectiva, motivará a los pacientes a participar activamente en el manejo de su salud.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Realizar alcance y seguimiento a pacientes mediante mensajes de video, consultas por video, llamadas telefónicas y mensajes de texto para educarlos e inscribirlos en el programa de adherencia.
  • Utilizar la comunicación por video como principal herramienta para ofrecer educación personalizada, orientación clínica y apoyo relacionado con la adherencia al tratamiento.
  • Proporcionar coaching clínico, manejo de casos y educación en salud con un enfoque empático y motivador para fomentar la adherencia a los medicamentos y cambios positivos en el estilo de vida.
  • Realizar conciliaciones de medicamentos mediante consultas por video, asegurando que los pacientes comprendan sus medicamentos, horarios de dosificación y la forma correcta de administrarlos.
  • Revisar los videos enviados por los pacientes mientras toman sus medicamentos para verificar la administración correcta, monitorear la adherencia e identificar posibles efectos secundarios o preocupaciones clínicas.
  • Crear videos educativos y motivacionales cortos para fortalecer el compromiso individual del paciente y promover la educación en salud a nivel poblacional.
  • Evaluar las necesidades médicas, conductuales y sociales de los pacientes y escalar los casos cuando sea necesario.
  • Brindar orientación sobre la administración de medicamentos, el uso correcto de inhaladores, el manejo de enfermedades crónicas y la seguridad de los medicamentos mediante sesiones de video en vivo y asincrónicas.
  • Servir como punto de escalamiento clínico para casos referidos por miembros no clínicos del equipo que requieran una evaluación clínica más especializada.
  • Ayudar a los pacientes con problemas técnicos relacionados con la aplicación móvil y la plataforma de adherencia de la empresa.
  • Mantener documentación completa y precisa de todas las interacciones con los pacientes, cumpliendo con las políticas de la empresa y los requisitos regulatorios.
  • Comunicarse con consultorios médicos, planes médicos y farmacias en representación del paciente cuando sea necesario para ayudar a eliminar barreras de acceso al tratamiento.
  • Referir pacientes a proveedores de servicios de salud y recursos comunitarios cuando corresponda, incluyendo comunicación directa con oficinas médicas y transferencias asistidas a otros proveedores de servicios.
  • Utilizar técnicas de entrevista motivacional durante las interacciones por video y otros medios digitales para fomentar estrategias de adherencia a largo plazo.
  • Ofrecer orientación sobre el uso adecuado de inhaladores, el manejo de enfermedades crónicas y la seguridad en el uso de medicamentos.
  • Contribuir a la mejora continua del programa mediante recomendaciones basadas en la experiencia con los pacientes, especialmente relacionadas con la comunicación por video, el monitoreo digital de la adherencia y las estrategias de educación al paciente.
  • Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para desarrollar y mejorar contenido educativo en video, protocolos clínicos y materiales educativos.

Requisitos

  • Debe ser residente legal de Puerto Rico
  • Licencia vigente como Enfermero(a) Registrado(a) (RN) en buen estado, con un mínimo de cinco (5) años de experiencia en enfermería.
  • Mínimo de cinco (5) años de experiencia en participación del paciente, educación en salud, coordinación de cuidados u otra función relacionada.
  • Dominio completo del inglés y del español (leer, escribir, hablar y comprender ambos idiomas con fluidez).
  • Sólida experiencia en manejo de enfermedades crónicas, adherencia a medicamentos y coaching de pacientes.
  • Excelentes destrezas de comunicación verbal y escrita con un enfoque cálido, profesional y empático.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en un ambiente dinámico y centrado en el paciente.
  • Conocimiento y manejo de expedientes electrónicos de salud (EHR), aplicaciones móviles y plataformas digitales de salud.
  • Comodidad para interactuar con pacientes mediante llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas y mensajería durante toda la jornada laboral.
  • Experiencia evaluando determinantes sociales de la salud y conectando pacientes con recursos disponibles.

Cualificaciones Preferidas

  • Experiencia en comunicación por video, telesalud, salud comunitaria o programas de salud digital.
  • Certificación como Coach de Salud (por ejemplo, Certified Health Coach, Integrative Health Coach u otra certificación equivalente) o disposición para obtenerla dentro del período establecido.
  • Conocimiento de modelos de Terapia de Observación Directa (Directly Observed Therapy o DOT).
  • Experiencia trabajando con poblaciones cubiertas por Medicaid y beneficiarios duales de Medicare y Medicaid (D-SNP).
  • Conocimiento de Salesforce u otras plataformas CRM.

Beneficios y Oportunidades

  • Salario competitivo y excelente paquete de beneficios.
  • Trabajo completamente remoto con la oportunidad de generar un impacto real en la vida de los pacientes.
  • Forme parte de una solución innovadora que enfrenta uno de los mayores retos del sistema de salud: la falta de adherencia a los medicamentos.
  • Colabore con profesionales apasionados de las áreas de salud, tecnología y salud pública.
  • Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo dentro de una empresa en rápida expansión.

El mayor beneficio de trabajar en Scene es formar parte de una solución innovadora que está transformando la atención médica junto a un equipo talentoso, comprometido y apasionado. Hasta la fecha, Scene ha impactado la vida de miles de personas, y usted desempeñará un papel clave para ampliar ese impacto.

Si es un(a) enfermero(a) compasivo(a), con afinidad por la tecnología y pasión por la educación del paciente y la adherencia a los medicamentos, ¡queremos conocerle! Solicite hoy mismo y únase a nuestro equipo para transformar la atención médica y ayudar a los pacientes a lograr mejores resultados de salud.

raw.description:
Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for a talented Product Designer to join our Product team, where you’ll work closely with Engineers and Product Managers to design products that are simple but great for the user, focusing on interaction, understanding and visual design.

You will have full stack design experience, able to get involved in both UX and UI tasks, including developing storyboards and wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to effectively communicate interaction and design ideas, as well as playing an active role in the feedback and iteration cycle.

We are looking for a critical thinker with an excellent visual and interaction design sense and an eye for making things better while working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What we expect

  • Track-record of designing a substantial project where your UX work has resulted in a demonstrable increase in user retention or acquisition.

  • Understanding and experience with User Centred Design Methodologies (UCD)

  • Ability to work with diverse stakeholder groups, taking on feedback and helping them articulate their business needs into changes that can be quickly implemented

  • Balancing user needs against business objectives and constraints.

  • Ensure that the design vision is executed correctly during the development process by building strong relationships with the engineering team for design reviews.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluent spoken and written English

Bonus points for:

  • Interest in emerging technologies in web, mobile, wearables, automotive and other devices

  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, Javascript and other web application technologies

  • Experience designing for a global audience in multiple languages

  • Familiarity with the agile software development process

  • Like maps and location based services (we love maps)

Equality, diversity and inclusion at what3words

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our hiring processes and company culture.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits to all permanent employees of what3words:

  • Competitive salary

  • Flexible working

  • 6 week remote working (work from anywhere) policy

  • 25 days holiday: plus the option to buy more!

  • Share options

  • Private health insurance

  • Wellbeing Days

  • Generous parental leave policies

  • Family friendly policies

  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

  • Team social budget

raw.description:
We are looking for a Content Lead to join our Marketing Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The Role

We're looking for a Content Lead to drive the brand positioning of M-KOPA Nigeria. This role is instrumental in increasing awareness, acquisition, engagement, and retention of customers, shaping the storytelling that shows up everywhere from blogs and newsletters to social posts and campaigns.

About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech platform that gives underbanked customers access to life-enhancing products and services, including smartphones, solar power, loans, and health insurance. We recently reached 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, and our asset-finance model has unlocked more than $2 billion in credit. 86% of our customers report an improved quality of life, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time. None of that happens without visual storytelling that people actually stop scrolling for.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our office in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Marketing Operations Manager.

What makes this different

This isn't a role where you write copy and hand it off. You'll develop and lead the storytelling direction for the M-KOPA brand, work closely with content creators, designers, and video and motion talent to bring stories to life, and have real ownership over how M-KOPA sounds everywhere it shows up.


What You'll Do

Storytelling & brand voice

  • Develop and lead the storytelling direction for the M-KOPA brand, spotting stories (inside the company, among users, in culture) and turning them into content people want to talk about.

  • Write and refine on-brand copy for social media, brand campaigns, website content, blogs, and landing pages, ensuring clarity, consistency, and conversion.

  • Make sure everything we publish sounds like M-KOPA and adds to our brand's voice and authority.

Content production & collaboration

  • Draft captions and short-form content for different platforms, pair copy with visuals alongside the design team, and create talking head videos.

  • Work with a content creator to bring stories to life through design, video, and motion.

  • Research and draft blog articles aligned with our content strategy, optimised for readability, SEO, and distribution.

Campaigns & strategy

  • Assist in developing content calendars and keep messaging aligned across blog, email, social, and ads.

  • Contribute creative ideas for campaigns and launches, and work with the marketing team on brainstorming, customer insights, and competitor research.

  • Stay ahead of local and global creative trends, tools, and platform updates, especially on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

What You'll Need

  • Demonstrable experience (3+ years) in a creative leadership or senior creative role, ideally with an advertising or creative agency background, comfortable with fast turnarounds, diverse briefs, and high-pressure environments.

  • Clean, engaging copywriting with a strong sense of voice and tone, and the ability to think in headlines, hooks, and thumb-stopping formats across platforms.

  • Deep understanding of the Nigerian consumer landscape and social media, especially TikTok, Facebook, and WhatsApp, with strong presentation skills to articulate creative concepts to non-creative stakeholders.

The honest part

This role moves fast. You'll be juggling blogs, captions, campaign copy, and brainstorms in the same week, often against tight deadlines. But if you want your words to be the thing that makes millions of people trust a brand with their money, this is where that happens.

If this sounds like the role you've been quietly hoping existed, let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

raw.description:
About Ume Intelligence

Ume Intelligence is a marketing science company solving complex commercial problems for multi-location restaurant brands. We build modern analytics and automation infrastructure, paired with hands-on digital operations that turn operational data into measurable revenue.
We operate as a lean, high-leverage team with no walls between engineering and operations. We look for marketers who run toward technology, automation, and data models rather than away from them—and who evaluate success by real business impact (margin, demand, and net revenue) rather than vanity metrics or campaigns launched. If you are technologically fearless, adapt quickly as tools evolve, and thrive at the intersection of data and execution, you will fit right in.

The Role

We are seeking a commercially minded, tech-fluent Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own end-to-end multi-channel marketing operations for our multi-location brand clients.
In this role, you sit at the intersection of technology and execution. You will run the digital engine driving revenue, margin, and foot traffic across paid media, local search, CRM, and third-party delivery platforms (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). You will act as the trusted operational partner to senior US brand stakeholders, using AI-native workflows and automated systems to operate with speed, precision, and leverage.


What You'll Own

  • Commercial Account Leadership & Communication: Act as the primary operational partner for assigned US multi-location accounts. Lead weekly client reviews, deliver data-backed performance reports, and communicate business impact directly to executive stakeholders.

  • Multi-Channel Growth Operations: Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid search (Google Ads), local search/SEO (Google Business Profile, Apple Maps), CRM/retention funnels, and social platforms.

  • Third-Party Delivery (3PD) Merchandising: Optimize digital storefronts, promotional calendars, and menu visibility across delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) to drive incremental profitable orders.

  • AI-Native Workflow Execution: Systematically leverage generative AI models and automation workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, custom scripts) across copy variations, competitor intelligence, reporting, and operational sprint tasks.

  • Data Synthesis & Business Impact: Track conversion metrics, ROAS, CAC, and store-level demand drivers. Transform messy multi-unit data into clear commercial insights and proactive optimization plans.

  • Cross-Disciplinary Coordination: Partner closely with internal technical teams, engineering workflows, and client leadership to ensure seamless marketing calendar execution and zero promotional downtime.

What You Bring

Experience & Background

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience driving multi-channel digital marketing operations (paid search, local search/listings, delivery aggregators, and CRM)

  • Prior experience in a tech company, high-growth startup, or fast-paced digital agency environment.

  • Proven track record managing client-facing relationships with US-based stakeholders, including leading live meetings and presenting data-heavy performance updates.

  • Relevant academic grounding (Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or Business). An MBA from a premier program (e.g., IIMs, ISB, or equivalent) is an advantage, but exceptional demonstrated analytical capability and commercial impact take precedence over credentials.

Core Competencies & Must-Haves

  • Commercial & Technical Fluency: Comfort with data structures, spreadsheets, unit economics, and modern software tools. You understand how marketing levers impact store-level P&Ls and inspect data directly instead of waiting on someone else to pull a report.

  • Practical AI & Automation Mastery: Daily operational comfort with LLMs and AI tools (prompt architecture, data synthesis, rapid drafting) to accelerate execution velocity without sacrificing quality.

  • Disciplined Project Management: Proficiency with modern sprint tracking and project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, etc.) with meticulous attention to detail and SOP integrity.

  • Executive-Level Communication: Flawless written and verbal English communication, suitable for presenting directly to US brand executives and operators.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience running promotions, menu management, and listings on DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub.

  • Background in multi-unit retail, franchise networks, or restaurant food & beverage operations.

  • Familiarity with listing automation platforms (e.g., Yext, BrightLocal) and advanced CRM workflows (e.g., Klaviyo, HubSpot).

Workspace & Connectivity Requirements

  • High-speed, reliable home internet connection available (minimum 200 Mbps with a secondary backup connection).

  • Dedicated, quiet, distraction-free remote home office setup for professional video conferencing.

How Performance Is Measured

You will have world-class proprietary tooling, automation engines, and state-of-the-art AI infrastructure at your fingertips—designed to eliminate low-value manual busywork and give you extraordinary leverage. With that leverage comes a high standard for analytical rigor, client empathy, and operational excellence:

  • Commercial Lift & Client Outcomes (35% Weight)
    We exist to drive measurable business impact for our brand partners. Success is evaluated on genuine client growth, not activity volume or campaigns launched.
    Target: Consistently achieving or exceeding client-specific margin, ROAS, foot-traffic, and incremental demand targets.

  • Operational Accuracy & Detail Rigor (30% Weight)
    In multi-location restaurant networks, precision is non-negotiable. Small mistakes in localized pricing, menu availability, promotional dates, or geo-targeting directly impact store-level P&Ls and brand trust.
    Target: Zero unforced errors on live client channels; disciplined adherence to pre-launch verification workflows and QA protocols.

  • Customer Centricity & Forward-Deployed Leadership (20% Weight)
    This is a high-visibility, forward-deployed role serving executive stakeholders at US brands. You act as an extension of their leadership team—anticipating operational bottlenecks, framing data with empathy for store operators, and leading crisp, high-value client reviews.
    Target: Proactive issue resolution before the client spots it, structured meeting agendas, and consistently high client satisfaction ratings.

  • Dependability & Execution Velocity (15% Weight)
    Operating across borders requires complete reliability. You maximize our modern toolchain to deliver work at speeds traditional teams cannot match, while maintaining seamless availability and collaboration during customer core hours.
    Target: 100% schedule consistency during US Pacific core hours, disciplined sprint follow-through, and measurable delivery speed gains powered by our internal technology stack.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Full-Time Compensation: Stable, competitive monthly base salary benchmarked for high-performing talent.

  • Meaningful Equity Participation: Opportunity to earn stock options and hold real equity upside in a venture-backed, high-growth US company as we scale.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid annual leave plus observed US national holidays.

  • High Leverage, Low Bureaucracy: Work with an agile, senior team where your work directly impacts company growth, with minimal meetings and zero political bloat.

  • Continuous Technical Growth: Direct immersion in cutting-edge marketing science, proprietary automation tools, and the latest enterprise AI workflows.
