raw.description:
The Customer Success Executive—US Manufacturing is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of high-value US Manufacturing accounts. This role carries full accountability for the commercial health and strategic growth of assigned accounts—operating with the ownership mentality of a general manager at the account level.

This is not an account-monitoring role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has personally driven demonstrable YoY growth within a large portfolio, built trusted executive relationships, and executed cross-functional motions that convert platform adoption into measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the primary post-sales customer executive for your accounts—a strategic advisor to manufacturing CIOs and senior IT leaders—and partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and peer CEG functions to ensure customers realize the full value of their ServiceNow investment and view us as a long-term digital transformation partner.

What you get to do in this role

  • Own account-level commercial performance. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal outcomes for your assigned accounts through proactive risk management, downsell prevention, and expansion motions.
  • Engage at the executive level as a strategic advisor. Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. Co-develop digital transformation strategies with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Bring relevant industry thought leadership and a consulting mindset to every engagement. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.
  • Translate customer strategy into a ServiceNow roadmap. Take each customer’s enterprise priorities—modernization, cost-out mandates, AI ambitions—and map them to a phased ServiceNow roadmap that connects platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bridge the gap between what the C-suite wants to achieve and how the platform gets them there.
  • Run complex transformations in our largest accounts. Own governance, delivery excellence, and cross-functional orchestration across multiple business units and concurrent workstreams—defining governance models aligned to business and platform strategy and evolving them as engagements scale.
  • Tell the story through data. Deliver compelling executive presentations—both internally and to customers—that articulate the value of ServiceNow through data-driven narratives. You are equally effective presenting a portfolio review to leadership and standing in front of a customer CIO making the case for platform expansion.
  • Drive AI consumption and platform adoption. Own AI consumption as a strategic KPI within your accounts. Design and execute adoption journeys that convert license entitlements into measurable business outcomes, with a focus on emerging agentic capabilities.
  • Set success metrics and drive value realization. Establish clear, measurable success metrics with each customer. Regularly review progress, proactively identify risks, and refine business transformation plans to

ensure milestones are met and value is realized. Work with internal teams and the customer to develop strategies that overcome barriers on the path to outcomes.

  • Champion the voice of the customer. Synthesize industry-specific feedback, feature requests, and adoption blockers into structured input for Product Engineering and roadmap prioritization. Stay current on manufacturing industry trends, regulatory environments, and digital transformation priorities shaping your accounts.
  • Operationalize customer health at scale. Define and manage operational KPIs for your portfolio—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Deliver regular reporting on customer health, adoption trends, downsell risk, and advocacy pipeline. Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms to automate insights and drive proactive outreach.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and a bias toward action that turns customer outcomes into revenue outcomes. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, value alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams, with a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

To be successful in this role, you will need

  • AI driven. Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Educational background. BA/BS or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience. 10–15 years of experience in management consulting, enterprise SaaS, senior customer success, or technology-enabled business transformation roles.
  • Strategic account ownership. Demonstrated experience operating as the primary post-sales customer success executive—owning the commercial outcomes, adoption trajectory, and renewal health. You drive long-term commercial strategy with a deep understanding of how to grow and protect strategic relationships.
  • Transformational leadership expertise. Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic account transformations and exceeding business objectives. Proven ability to build repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed.
  • Business acumen. Exceptional commercial instincts. You think in portfolio economics, understand the interplay between adoption, consumption, and revenue, and can translate customer outcomes into business impact narratives that resonate with Finance, Sales leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Executive presence and C-suite engagement. Proven ability to engage at the C-suite level—both with customers and internally. Direct experience partnering with CIOs and senior IT executives to co-develop digital transformation strategies. You bring gravitas, credibility, and the ability to influence without relying on positional authority.
  • Data storytelling. Ability to translate complex adoption metrics, value realization, and portfolio performance into executive-level narratives that drive decisions.
  • Cross-functional collaboration. Strong track record building productive relationships across Sales, Presales, Delivery, Product, and Enablement in matrixed, fast-paced environments. You lead through influence, not org-chart authority.
  • Customer centricity and industry awareness. Deep understanding of how manufacturing enterprises operate, what drives their priorities, and where friction lives. You instinctively orient around the customer’s outcomes—anticipating concerns, removing barriers to satisfaction, and ensuring every interaction reinforces ServiceNow’s position as a trusted partner. Familiarity with adjacent verticals (Energy, Transportation, Services) is a plus.
  • Platform knowledge. Experience overseeing technical account health—adoption telemetry, integration health, platform upgrades, and solution expansion. Background with AI/ML platform products or driving AI adoption programs is a significant differentiator.
  • Adaptability and travel. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment. Willingness to travel domestically to strategic customer sites as required.

raw.title: Chief of Staff - Vice President of HIV, Hepatitis, and TB
raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
raw.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

The Chief of Staff works as the right hand to the Vice President who leads CHAI's HIV, Hepatitis, and TB cluster, a growing portfolio of three disease programs working with governments, suppliers, communities, partners, and donors. You will join senior leadership on the cluster's most visible work, from donor pitches to board presentations, and see how decisions get made across a global organization. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the direction of programs that reach millions of people in low- and middle-income countries.

The role has two main parts. The first is communication and synthesis: gathering input from program teams and turning it into the decks, briefs, pre-reads, and talking points the VP uses with donors and partners. Doing this well takes an analytical mind, since you will often need to work through data or pressure-test an argument before it's ready for the VP. Presentations are a large part of this, and you will build executive-quality decks yourself. The second is leading special projects for the VP, typically cross-cutting efforts that no single program team owns. Some will be planned, such as coordinating a joint donor proposal across teams, and others will call for surge support on an urgent VP priority, such as project managing the development of an investment case. For each, you will scope the work, set the plan, bring in the right people, and see it through to a result. Across both parts of the role, you will prepare the VP for key meetings, follow up on what was agreed, and help the VP decide where to spend time by triaging incoming requests and flagging what needs a decision. You will work closely with leadership across the three programs, who keep ownership of their technical work.

The base location is flexible as long as you can consistently work East Coast hours, and some travel will be required.

Responsibilities

Communications and Synthesis

  • Work with program leadership to develop presentations, briefs, memos, pre-reads, and talking points that help senior leaders understand complex topics, make decisions, and communicate priorities.
  • Produce board-, CEO-, and donor-facing presentations that are clear, rigorous, and visually sharp, often on short timelines.
  • Translate cost-effectiveness analysis and market and epidemiological data into narratives a non-specialist can follow and act on.
  • Maintain a high standard for all materials leaving the VP's office.

Special Projects

  • Lead cross-cutting projects the VP sponsors, such as coordinating a joint donor proposal across program teams: define the problem, build the work plan, bring in the right people, and see the work through to a result.
  • Provide surge-support on urgent VP priorities, such as project managing the development of an investment case.
  • Track milestones, owners, and dependencies for these projects, and coordinate external inputs such as consultants and vendors to keep deliverables on time and to standard.
  • Identify gaps and troubleshoot challenges as they surface, taking ownership and working with cluster leadership to resolve them.

Fundraising and Resource Mobilization

  • Work with teams to develop compelling donor-facing materials, including concept notes, proposals, budget narratives, and pitch decks that make a sharp case for investment.
  • Prepare the VP for donor and partner meetings with briefings, positioning, talking points, and follow-up tracking.

Prioritization and Follow-Through

  • Act as the VP's trusted strategic partner, developing clear analyses and actionable recommendations on the cluster's highest priorities, in close partnership and with input from the relevant program leads.
  • Keep a clear view of the VP's and cluster's top objectives, and help the VP decide among competing demands and where attention is most needed.
  • Help the VP frame decisions, weigh trade-offs, and anticipate what is coming across workstreams.
  • Connect the cluster's OKR process to the VP's agenda, flagging work that is off track or requires the VP's input.
  • Triage what comes into the VP's office, synthesizing and routing what requires a decision.
  • Prepare the VP for CEO, board, senior leadership, and partner engagements.
  • Follow up on agreed actions, identify blockers, and escalate issues requiring the VP's intervention.

Cluster Alignment and Coordination

  • Build strong relationships across HIV, TB, and Hepatitis leadership and the wider organization, using them to anticipate risks and support alignment across teams.
  • Manage the cadence of cluster leadership meetings, including agendas, decisions, and follow-ups.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and, as a guide, six or more years of professional experience in management consulting, global health, strategy, operations, or a comparable environment.
  • Exceptional at producing content, especially in PowerPoint, with a demonstrated track record of independently building executive-quality decks as well as concept notes, briefs, and talking points. Strong visual and data storytelling is essential, and candidates should be ready to share recent decks they built themselves.
  • Strong technical writing skills and ability to synthesize at an executive level.
  • Sound judgment about confidentiality; ability to manage sensitive information and communications with discretion.
  • Fluency with AI tools in everyday work, including research, synthesis, and drafting, and the judgment to check their output and recognize where they fall short.
  • Proven project management ability: building plans across a diverse set of stakeholders and driving complex projects to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Experience developing fundraising or business-development materials such as proposals, concept notes, or pitches.
  • Exceptional research, writing, and structured problem-solving skills, with the judgment to know what the VP actually needs.
  • Comfortable creating structure for new or loosely defined work, and the drive to get hands dirty across a range of tasks.
  • Confident managing up and taking initiative, with the presence to work effectively with senior leaders.
  • Candour, including willingness to disagree with the VP.
  • A deep commitment to CHAI's mission and values.

Competencies

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated individual with a genuine desire to maximize global health outcomes. An ideal candidate will be:

  • Insightful: draws clear conclusions from a large amount of analysis, quickly grasps new programs and their key issues, and understands how a single workstream fits into larger priorities.
  • Independent: plans an efficient approach to hard problems, proactively takes the next step, and reliably delivers.
  • Practical: exercises judgment in allocating effort to what is decision-critical, and re-prioritizes as circumstances change.
  • Analytical: comfortable with quantitative and qualitative data, and able to extract logical conclusions and recommendations from it.
  • Communicative: navigates varied and sensitive stakeholder environments, from in-country teams to senior donor executives, and is an exceptional writer of both memos and presentation materials.
  • Rigorous: holds a high bar and produces work that stands up to internal and external scrutiny.
  • Adaptable: comfortable with ambiguity and shifting scope, quick to ramp on new topics, and able to develop expertise on a steep learning curve.

There is no 'perfect' candidate for this role. We are more interested in aptitude, judgment, and excitement for the work than in a fixed set of years or experiences, and we are open to a range of seniority to find the right fit. If this role excites you, please apply.

Advantages

  • Experience in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment such as strategy consulting, investment banking, or pharma.
  • Exposure to HIV, TB, hepatitis, or infectious-disease programming, or to market shaping, procurement, or access-to-medicines work.
  • Experience developing proposals and pitches in a fundraising or development function in the social-impact space.
  • Experience working remotely with a decentralized team
  • Experience working in or supporting low- and middle-income countries.

Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About You

You've owned CX quality at a contact center scale of 200+ agents (in-house or BPO), built a QA framework from rubric through calibration, and shipped training programs that measurably moved agent performance. You're equally comfortable in a Looker dashboard and a Zendesk Guide CMS. You've worked alongside or implemented an AI deflection product (Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought) and can speak credibly about what makes AI-mediated support actually work.

Role Summary

As Senior Manager of CX Enablement, you will own the quality, training, and knowledge management systems that power Imprint's customer experience. This is a strategic leadership role combining QA framework design, AI-powered deflection enablement, knowledge base ownership, and agent training excellence.

You will drive the architecture that connects quality inputs to AI systems (Sierra), knowledge management, and training outputs—ensuring content quality compounds rather than degrades as Imprint scales. You'll partner closely with engineering, ops, product, and vendor teams to transform customer support from reactive to proactive through automation, rigorous quality frameworks, and data-driven training strategies.

This role reports directly to the Director of Customer Operations and manages a small team of 2–3 associates focused on execution and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Completed a comprehensive knowledge base audit with defined ownership model between CS, engineering, and ops, including refresh SLAs in Zendesk

  • Designed and shipped a new QA framework that moves from manual contact center approaches to fully automated quality scoring with clear expectations

  • Established Sierra AI deflection enablement system with daily feedback loops, gap detection, and content optimization for AI ingestion and delivery

  • Built a scalable partner launch QA and training strategy and applied it to an active launch with measurable quality improvements over prior launches

  • Created a structured training rehaul plan in collaboration with our outsourcing partner, focusing on strategic oversight and outcome monitoring

  • Established trusted partnerships with key cross-functional stakeholders including vendor ops, AI product team, partner success, compliance, and legal

Responsibilities

  • Own the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management frameworks that drive consistent agent performance across omnichannel support

  • Lead knowledge base strategy and operations in Zendesk, including content audits, ownership models, refresh cadence, and optimization for both human agents and AI consumption

  • Drive Sierra AI deflection strategy by analyzing feedback data, identifying content gaps, optimizing knowledge for LLM ingestion, and improving customer-facing AI delivery

  • Partner with Imprints BPO training teams to design and monitor training programs that address systemic quality issues, leverage AI automation, and scale effectively with new partner launches

  • Build and maintain the technical architecture that connects quality inputs (QA automation, CSAT, sentiment analysis) to training outputs and knowledge base improvements

  • Use data from QM platforms, Sierra AI, and CSAT to diagnose root causes of quality issues—differentiating agent behavior from systemic or content gaps

  • Lead partner launch readiness by designing QA strategies, training plans, and content requirements that prevent launch failures and training debt

  • Establish cross-functional collaboration rhythms with vendor ops, engineering, product, fraud ops, partner success, compliance, and legal teams

  • Manage and develop a team of 2–3 associates responsible for execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality and training operations

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in customer experience, with 4+ years in quality management, training, enablement, or knowledge management roles

  • Experience owning CX quality, training, and enablement at scale (100+ agents, in-house or outsourced), ideally omnichannel

  • Hands-on experience implementing AI-powered deflection projects using tools like Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought, or comparable LLM-based platforms

  • Strong technical fluency with CX platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk Guide and Support, or comparable knowledge base and support systems (not homegrown tools)

  • Experience with QM platforms such as Maestro QA, Klaus, Playbox, Stella Connect, Tether AI, or similar quality automation tools

  • Exceptional writing skills with the ability to produce compliance-ready content that requires minimal iteration with legal or regulatory teams

  • Data fluency: able to analyze QA trends, CSAT drivers, sentiment data, and agent performance metrics to identify systemic issues vs. behavior gaps

  • Bias toward action and shipping—comfortable building frameworks that get adopted, not just designed

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI is transforming customer service, with a demonstrated commitment to staying at the forefront of CX automation

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, regulated environments, or industries with complex compliance requirements

  • Familiarity with training LMS tools and designing scalable learning programs

  • Background in customer education, support operations, or contact center quality leadership

  • Experience working with outsourced BPO partners and driving adoption of new quality or training standards

  • Track record of redesigning legacy QA or training systems into modern, automated frameworks

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Job Description

Join Us as a Resource Analyst – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation


As a Resource Analyst, you will forecast, track and identify resource allocation needs, assignments, and availability for assigned projects. You will support the efficient utilization and forecasting of labor needs of clinical resources in each assigned geographical area through evaluation and analysis. Responsibilities also include ensuring appropriate composition of project teams to enable presentation of appropriate clinical teams to clients and impacting the performance and profitability of project teams from a quality, operational and financial aspect across all therapeutic areas.

What You'll Do:
• Track and identify resource needs and assignments. Coordinate the intake,
follow up and resolution of all resource requests. Maintain project module in the

system.

  • Evaluate resource requests, availability and assignments with other areas to
    assure resourcing needs in all areas are met. Identify staff for assignments
    based on client requirements, employee background, therapeutic requirements,
    geographical area, availability.
    • Lead weekly resourcing needs and meetings. Distribute resourcing reports.
    Update roll-off dates and assignments for all clinical resources of projects
    managed by respective area. Actively participate and contribute to
    agenda/discussion during routine meetings for area Resource Analysts.
    • Coordinate, track and distribute CVs as needed. Liaise with CV administrator
    group to ensure CVs are accurate and up-to-date.
    • Liaise with internal departments to prioritize resourcing needs and assignments
    for future work, RFPs and bid defense meetings.
    • Utilize resourcing dashboards, and other available tools to reconcile and QC
    departmental reports, including monthly resourcing projections and utilization
    reports for senior management.
    • Identify and submit proposals of available resources based on availability and
    experience.
    • Undertake special projects with a goal of ongoing improvement and
    streamlining the resourcing function including long range metrics and
    projections.
    • Mentor and assist in training of new staff as necessary.
    Education and Experience Requirements:
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 3+ years’) or equivalent combination of education, training, & experience.

    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
    • Knowledge of project resourcing and forecasting and applicable tools for tracking and forecasting needs
    • Proficient knowledge of MS Office including Outlook and Excel
    • Effective problem solving and facilitation skills
    • Knowledge of relational databases and ability to generate reports
    • Able to gather, interpret and evaluate information from a variety of resources to make decisions and recommendations
    • Good quantitative and analytical ability
    • Excellent attention to detail
    • Able to manage multiple projects and multitask with little supervision
    • Good verbal and written communication skills
    • Knowledge of expectations and resourcing needed to effectively staff project teams to promote business goals and future authorizations

    Working Environment:
    Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

    • Work is performed in an office or clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
    • Occasional drives to site locations. Potential Occasional travel required.

    Why join us?
    When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

    Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

raw.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 5–7 Years

About the Role

We are seeking a PostgreSQL Database Administrator with hands-on experience supporting production database environments. The role focuses on PostgreSQL administration, performance tuning, monitoring, backup and recovery, replication, and production incident management, with a strong emphasis on database reliability and availability.

Job Description

The role involves providing L1/L2 production support for PostgreSQL environments, including database monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and incident resolution. You will perform routine DBA activities such as backups, restores, patching, upgrades, replication management, and capacity planning.

You will also monitor database health using Grafana and Prometheus or similar tools, investigate performance issues, optimize queries and indexes, and support high-availability and disaster-recovery environments. The position requires close collaboration with development, infrastructure, and on-call teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L1/L2 production support for PostgreSQL databases, including monitoring and incident resolution.
  • Perform backups, restores, patching, upgrades, replication management, and capacity planning.
  • Monitor database health and performance using Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools.
  • Troubleshoot slow queries, locking, deadlocks, indexing issues, and other performance bottlenecks.
  • Manage database users, roles, and permissions according to security best practices.
  • Support high availability, streaming replication, failover, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Collaborate with development teams on schema changes, migrations, and query reviews.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and production documentation.

Required Skills

  • PostgreSQL Database Administration
  • 3–6 years of hands-on PostgreSQL DBA experience in production support environments.
  • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL architecture, replication, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Backup and recovery using pg_dump, pg_basebackup, WAL-based backups, pgBackRest, or Barman.
  • Grafana and Prometheus or similar database monitoring tools.
  • Linux system administration relevant to database operations.
  • Strong SQL skills, including query review and optimization.
  • Production incident troubleshooting and resolution.
  • High availability and disaster recovery concepts.

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Citus distributed PostgreSQL extension for sharding and horizontal scaling.
  • Python for automation scripts, monitoring tools, or maintenance utilities.
  • Cloud-managed PostgreSQL services such as AWS RDS/Aurora, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, or GCP Cloud SQL.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Connection pooling tools such as PgBouncer or Pgpool-II.
  • ITIL or incident management processes.

Mandatory Skills

  • DB2-DB Administration
  • PostgreSQL-DB Administration

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 3–6 years of production PostgreSQL DBA experience with strong expertise in database administration, performance tuning, monitoring, replication, and recovery. The candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with engineering, infrastructure, and on-call teams in a fast-paced production support environment.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients

About HeyMax

HeyMax turns everyday spending into travel. Users earn Max Miles on the things they already buy, and redeem them for flights, hotels, and experiences worldwide. Founded in 2023, we're live in Singapore and Hong Kong — and building toward a product that works for anyone, anywhere in the world.

The role — a mini lab inside HeyMax

You'll run a growth and expansion design lab: a small, autonomous unit with one mandate — grow HeyMax's user base, anywhere in the world. That means the full growth surface: how new users discover and activate, how existing users deepen and refer, and how the experience flexes for markets and users we haven't designed for yet. You operate like a startup within the startup — pick the highest-leverage problem, ship an experiment, read the data, decide what's next.

What you'll own

  • Global activation — the entire journey from first touch to first value moment, designed to work for any user in any market from day one. This is the engine that lets HeyMax launch a country without rebuilding the product.
  • One experience, every market — an adaptive design system where the product reconfigures itself around user state and market maturity. You're not designing screens per country; you're designing the rules that make one product serve a hundred markets.
  • Compounding growth loops — referral, sharing, and re-engagement mechanics built to scale across borders. Every experiment you ship becomes reusable infrastructure for the next market.
  • The lab's playbook — you set the growth agenda, run the experiment portfolio, and build the repeatable expansion playbook the whole company will run on.

Who you are

  • 5+ years consumer product design, with real growth work — you've owned an activation or acquisition funnel metric, not just designed alongside one.
  • Systems thinker: you design state machines, not screens. "What does this surface look like with 1 partner / 10 partners" is a question you ask before drawing anything.
  • AI-native: AI tools are your default for prototyping, research synthesis, and copy variants — you move at lab speed because of it. Bonus: you've designed agent or copilot patterns.
  • Comfortable with the ambiguity of a market you can't visit — you design research-cheap ways to learn (fake-door tests, concierge MVPs, remote unmoderated tests).

We move fast, think deeply, and build with purpose. Our culture is rooted in entrepreneurship, innovation, and collaboration - along with shared wins, team dinners, and a whole lot of good food and laughter.

We’re a team of doers, and boundary-breakers - product, data, R&D, growth, and creative talent who own the full stack of how consumer brands are built and scaled today. As part of the creative team, you will work closely with the Media, CRO and brand teams, create and adapt content for different platforms and audiences, and continuously improve videos based on performance data and feedback, utilizing AI tools and improving them. This is a fast-paced B2C environment that requires strong storytelling, excellent execution, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Why Join Us?

At Kendago, you'll work alongside top-tier professionals in a fast-moving, high-impact environment. We take pride in our direct, transparent, and warm organizational culture, where personal connection is just as important as professional excellence.

  • Knowledge and understanding of digital advertising and web best practices.

  • A conceptual thinker and a strong problem solver.
  • An effective multitasker with a proactive, can-do attitude.
  • A collaborative team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Create performance-driven video ads for digital platforms.

  • Create multiple versions, formats, and creative iterations for campaign testing.

  • Use campaign data results and draw performance conclusions to improve future creative output and create the next test iterations.
  • Collaborate closely with creative strategists, designers, copywriters, and media teams.
  • Manage several projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of quality.

About Perseus Payments Inc.

Perseus Payments Inc. builds PerseusPay, a purpose-built payments platform serving marine, OPE, and RV dealers across the US and Canada. PerseusPay processes card-present and card-not-present payments and integrates deeply with dealer DMS systems, and provides settlement, analytics, and reporting capabilities to hundreds of dealer locations.

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong Software Developer to join the PerseusPay team in a Technical Support capacity. This is not a traditional support role — it sits at the intersection of software engineering and customer success. You will be the first line of technical defence for production issues, working directly with dealer customers and internal stakeholders to triage, diagnose, and resolve problems quickly.

You will have direct read access to production systems, be comfortable reading application logs and database queries, and be able to identify root causes in a payments platform that handles real-time transactions. You will also collaborate with the engineering team to surface patterns, escalate bugs, and contribute to long-term fixes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor production environments during core business hours, proactively identifying anomalies in payment processing, settlements, and integrations before customers report them; available for after-hours response for critical incidents when required.

  • Triage inbound support requests from dealers and internal teams — classify severity, reproduce issues, isolate root cause, and communicate a clear status and ETA.

  • Investigate issues using Datadog logs, Azure Application Insights, and SQL queries against production data to determine whether problems are data, configuration, integration, or code related.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for dealers experiencing payment, terminal, or settlement issues — communicating clearly and professionally in writing and on calls.

  • Write and execute diagnostic SQL queries to validate data integrity, trace transaction lifecycles, and identify anomalies in payment, refund, and settlement records.

  • Coordinate with the Payment processor support team on payment gateway issues.

  • Document resolved issues, workarounds, and root causes in the team knowledge base to accelerate future triage.

  • Identify recurring patterns and escalate systemic bugs to the engineering team with wellstructured reproduction steps and impact assessments.

  • Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to runbooks and incident response playbooks.

  • Assist with code changes or configuration fixes for straightforward, well-understood issues.

  • Able to fix, test and deploy code and configuration changes in production on their own.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a technical support, software development with direct exposure to production systems.

The Product Manager leads the strategy, design, and delivery of solutions for Medicare, Medicaid, and ACA Risk Adjustment programs. A key focus is enabling interoperable data exchange across clinical and administrative systems.   • Support implementations and program year transitions, ensuring configuration changes are successfully deployed.
  • Contribute to long-term product strategy, emphasizing scalability, interoperability, automation, and regulatory readiness.

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

Open Application

Don’t see a role that’s the right fit right now, and are currently living in - and authorized to work in - one of the countries mentioned above? We’d still love to hear from you. Submit an open application by clicking ‘Apply Now’ and answering a few quick questions. We’ll keep your CV on file for a year, and if the perfect opportunity comes up, we’ll be in touch!

Compensation & Benefits

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
  • A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko. We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.

  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. The role

You'll be our first senior marketing hire and the owner of the entire marketing function. Today, marketing at AuthorClimb is a set of working channels run close to the founder. Your job is to turn it into a system: sharpen the positioning, decide where we spend and why, and build the team that executes it. This is a player-coach role. You'll set strategy and you'll also write the launch email yourself when that's the fastest path.

You'll report directly to the founder and, as the team grows, manage our content and growth marketing hires.

What you'll do

  • Own marketing strategy and the full funnel, from first impression through free trial to paid subscription

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging for a skeptical, ambitious audience of self-published authors

  • Set the channel mix across paid social, search, SEO content, email, and partnerships, and decide where the next dollar goes

  • Define the metrics that matter, build honest measurement around them, and report on what's working without spin

  • Run launches end to end: new tools, pricing changes, research reports, and brand moments

  • Hire, manage, and develop the marketing team, starting with content and growth roles

  • Write. Landing pages, emails, positioning docs. The bar for prose here is high

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in marketing with at least 2 years leading a function or team

  • Experience growing a subscription software product, ideally one sold to prosumers or small businesses rather than enterprises

  • A genuinely strong writer. You'll be asked for writing samples

  • Fluency with funnel data: you can pull your own numbers, question an attribution story, and change course when the evidence says to

  • A player-coach temperament: you've built strategy and you still enjoy shipping the work

  • Comfortable being the most senior marketer in the room and owning outcomes without a playbook handed to you

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with self-publishing, the creator economy, or marketplaces where individuals run small businesses

  • Lifecycle and email marketing depth

  • Experience building or repositioning a brand, not just running channels

Compensation & benefits

  • $130,000–$165,000 base salary, depending on experience

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible PTO plus company holidays

  • $1,000 home-office setup budget

  • An annual book stipend, naturally

How we work

We're fully remote across the US, with a home base in the Boston area. The team is small, communication is mostly written and async, and there's no layer between you and the founder. Work ships quickly and gets in front of real authors the same week.

Equal opportunity

AuthorClimb is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated.
raw.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands and launching very soon in Luxembourg and Austria. Backed by 17 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system.

🔎 What's in it for you

As a B2B Partner Operations Specialist, you will be a trusted operational partner to EPI’s member banks and payment partners, ensuring they receive not only timely assistance but also high-quality, personal support experience. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and a shared commitment to delivering a product that works for its users. Beyond resolving inquiries, you’ll actively contribute to improving our products and support experience, ensuring that every interaction strengthens confidence in EPI.

At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join a dedicated, member-facing support team that values collaboration, shared learning, and empathy. We work closely with both technical and operational colleagues to ensure that our member banks and by extension, their customers can rely on EPI with confidence. You’ll report to the Manager of Customer Support and be part of an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for service quality.

💥Your impact

  • Service Relationship Management: Serve as the primary relationship contact for assigned member banks, PSPs, and other B2B partners. Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships through regular check-ins, proactive communication, and a deep understanding of each member bank's operational context and priorities. Act as the voice of the member bank internally, ensuring their needs and feedback are represented across EPI teams.

  • Case Management & SLO Ownership: Own and manage support cases through Jira Service Desk with care and professionalism, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution in line with SLOs. Go beyond closing tickets — focus on identifying recurring themes, driving root-cause resolution, and creating clarity and trust through transparent case communication with member banks through a results-orientated approach.

  • Data Analysis & Performance Reporting: Perform regular analyses on support data, incident trends, SLO performance, and member bank health metrics using tools such as Databricks. Translate findings into clear, actionable insights and present KPI reporting and trend analyses to both internal stakeholders and member bank audiences during operational meetings.

  • Member Bank Communication & Advisory Lead: proactive and reactive communication with member banks during incidents, service changes, and general updates. Where EPI identifies opportunities for member banks to improve their services to consumers, initiate and coordinate advisory conversations, helping member banks understand recommendations and supporting them through implementation.

  • Issue Escalation & Resolution: Act as a reliable point of contact for complex issues. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure critical problems are escalated and resolved with care and urgency. During Major Incidents, keep member banks actively informed and reassured throughout the entire lifecycle — from detection through resolution.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration:Work closely with second- and third-line teams to improve product functionality and member bank experience. Actively involve other support teams when needed, fostering a culture of shared responsibility. Channel insights from member bank interactions and data analyses into concrete process and product improvement proposals.

  • Operational Onboarding: Support member banks during their onboarding journey, ensuring they receive the training and guidance needed to operate confidently within the EPI ecosystem. Coordinate and maintain access rights according to RBAC roles, ensuring a secure and frictionless experience.

  • Knowledge Sharing & Quality:Keep the internal knowledge base up to date, reflecting lessons learned, best practices, and evolving member bank needs. Streamline internal processes and enhance the team's usage of tools to drive efficiency and consistency across the support function.

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a B2B partner support, or client-facing operations role, ideally in fintech, payments, or tech.

  • Strong communication skills (EN), both written and verbal, with a collaborative and consultative mindset. Additional European languages (FR, DE, NL) are a strong plus.

  • A genuine interest in payments and a desire to understand the value EPI delivers to its member banks and end users.

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with external partners, such as banks, and PSPs — including running regular check-ins and operational reviews.

  • Comfortable presenting data, SLO performance, and operational insights to both internal stakeholders and external audiences.

  • Ability to perform data analysis (e.g., in Excel, Databricks, or similar tools) to identify trends, spot anomalies, and support reporting with evidence rather than assumptions.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to prioritise and stay organised in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience with Jira Service Management (or similar case management/CRM tools) is essential.

  • Openness to feedback, a growth mindset, and the ability to adapt quickly.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters

  2. An interview with our Member support team

  3. A final interview with the Team Lead

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can't refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You are looking for a highly structured BAU routine

  • You shy away from pro-actively reaching out to other teams for support

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus, and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits program

  • The opportunity to be part of a multicultural European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

What we do

Snezzi helps brands show up in AI answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, and others. We handle everything end to end: audits, content, technical fixes, backlinks, and measurement. Fully done for you.

We're a small team of second-time founders. We ship weekly. We run AI agents for most of our internal work. And we're growing fast enough that we need sharp people who want to learn this space by doing real work, not by watching from the sidelines.

What this internship actually is

You'll work on live client accounts from week one. That means real audits, real fixes, real reporting. Not shadowing. Not slide decks. Not busywork.

By the end of the engagement, you'll have shipped actual work, built skills that are genuinely hard to find right now, and have a portfolio that proves it.

Strong performers convert to full-time. We'll tell you early if we see that path for you.

What you'll do

  • Run AI visibility audits across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode

  • Help identify gaps and assist with fixes: content updates, schema, technical cleanup

  • Use Claude Code and other AI tools to build and run scripts (no prior coding required — you learn by doing)

  • Help prepare client reports, weekly updates, and pre-reads

  • Document and templatize every process you touch so the next person can use it

Tools you'll use

Claude Code, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Shopify, WordPress. You'll learn them on the job. What matters is how fast you pick things up.

Who we're looking for

You don't need a specific degree or years of experience. You need the right instincts.

Must-haves:

  • You use AI tools a lot, out of curiosity, not just to finish assignments

  • You write clearly. Most of this job is communication: with clients, with AI agents, with your team.

  • A terminal or a code file doesn't scare you. You don't need to write code, but if Claude generates a script, you can run it, read the output, and ask Claude to fix what broke.

  • You try before you ask. "I don't know" is a starting point, not an excuse.

  • You want to ship things, not just observe them.

Moves you to the top of the pile:

  • You've built or shipped anything on the internet: a blog, a store, a tool, a side project, a newsletter

  • You've poked around GA4 or Search Console before

  • You've written content for a brand or website

  • You've done any kind of SEO, growth, or content work

Not a fit if:

  • You think prompting an AI handles everything. Taste and judgment still matter.

  • You want clean handoffs and tightly scoped tasks

  • Client-facing work makes you uncomfortable

raw.description:
About Flexxon

Flexxon is a Singapore-headquartered hardware technology company engineering embedded storage solutions built for the world's most demanding environments.

From factory floors to hospital wards, vehicle control units to aircraft avionics bays, Flexxon products are built into systems where failure isn't an option and a breach can mean lives, not just data, are at risk.

We're growing our marketing team and looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can identify the opportunities, translate deep technical differentiation into a value proposition that resonates with engineers, procurement teams, and C-suite buyers across five demanding verticals.

The Role

You'll own product marketing for Flexxon's storage portfolio, working cross-functionally with engineering, sales, and design to turn technical capability into positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution that wins in Industrial, Medical, Automotive, Aerospace, and Cybersecurity-first accounts.

This is a role for someone who can sit in a room with a firmware engineer in the morning, procurement team at noon and product manager in the evening — and be equally credible in both conversations.

What You'll Own

  • Go-to-market execution — Partner with campaigns, content, design, and events teams to plan and launch product messaging across web, sales decks, trade shows, and digital channels.
  • Cross-functional bridge — Work closely with procurement, engineering and product teams to stay ahead of the roadmap and ensure marketing claims are technically defensible.
  • Customer & market research — Engage directly with design-in customers and industry analysts to validate positioning and surface unmet needs by vertical.
  • Vertical positioning & messaging — Build and maintain differentiated value propositions for each target vertical, translating technical specs (endurance, temperature tolerance, tamper-resistance, real-time threat detection) into business outcomes buyers care about.
  • Competitive intelligence — Track competitor storage and embedded-security offerings; identify gaps and craft positioning that highlights Flexxon's hardware-level advantage.
  • Sales enablement — Develop battlecards, one-pagers, ROI narratives, and technical collateral that arm the sales team for vertical-specific conversations.

The Value Proposition You'll Champion

Vertical

What You'll Position

Industrial

Rugged, wide-temperature-range storage built for 24/7 operation in harsh, high-vibration environments — where commodity SSDs fail early and unpredictably.

Medical

Data integrity and tamper-evidence for life-critical systems, supporting compliance needs and protecting patient data at the hardware layer, not just the software layer.

Automotive

Long-lifecycle, high-endurance storage engineered for the extended service life and extreme conditions of connected and autonomous vehicle platforms.

Aerospace

Mission-critical reliability and security for systems that can't be patched mid-flight — where hardware-rooted protection is the last line of defense.

Cybersecurity

Hardware-embedded, tamper-resistant storage that protects data at the controller level — security that holds even when the operating system above it is compromised.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product marketing, technical marketing, or product management experience, ideally in semiconductor, storage, embedded systems, or B2B hardware.
  • Experience with competitive analysis, market sizing, and go-to-market planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate deep technical differentiation into clear, buyer-relevant messaging.
  • Experience marketing into regulated or safety-critical industries (industrial, medical, automotive, or aerospace) is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineering teams to understand and accurately represent technical capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write a technical battlecard and present to a CEO in the same week.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with NAND flash, SSD, or embedded storage architecture.
  • Background in cybersecurity or hardware-rooted security marketing.
  • Experience supporting design-in sales cycles with OEM or Tier 1 customers.

What You'll Get

  • A seat at the table on a fast-growing, technically differentiated product line with genuine category advantage.
  • Direct exposure to CEO-level strategy sessions and cross-functional decision-making.
  • A collaborative team spanning development, SEO/content, design, video, campaigns, and events.

raw.description:
About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams, helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most.

Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day-to-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role, not a platform architecture or people management position.

This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field-based teams to understand day-to-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven automation
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly
  • Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations
  • Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting-team leadership to define priorities
  • Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams
  • Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day-to-day tasks
  • Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance
  • Monitor day-to-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team
  • Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations, including those handling protected health information (PHI)
  • Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI-driven workflows
  • Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization
  • Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams
  • Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire

Qualifications

Required

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no-code/low-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows
  • Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency
  • Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture
  • Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Experience in the healthcare industry; familiarity with clinical operations, call center or care support workflows, or field-based care models is a plus
  • Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools
  • Familiarity with value-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments
  • Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field-based teams
  • Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth organization where priorities evolve

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field-based teams through deployed automations
  • Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users
  • A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production
  • Efficient intake-to-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment
  • Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization
  • Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows
  • Active contribution to a growing culture of AI-native thinking across the organization

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement. It's the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

Working at Matter Health

We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date.

Health & Wellness

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Employer-funded HSA options

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage
  • Access to Matter Health's in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

• Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match starting on Day 60
  • Financial wellness resources and support

Time Away

• Up to 4 weeks of PTO

• 10 paid company holidays

  • 2 volunteer days annually for meaningful causes

Eligibility is based on full-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Matter Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and foster an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

Job Title: Entry-Level HR Manager

Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)

Company: Everglade Works

Job Type: Full-Time | Entry Level | Remote

About the Role

This isn't your typical HR generalist role with a fancy title. At Everglade Works, were scaling fast, and we need someone who's ready to step into the drivers seat of day-to-day HR operations. This is a hands-on position for someone who wants to understand the rea workings of people management in a growing IT company.

You'll work side-by-side (virtually) with leadership to help build and maintain a workplace that runs smoothly, keeps people engaged, and ensures the human side of the business is just as sharp as the tech.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage onboarding from A to Z paperwork, tools, welcome calls, the works
  • Coordinate with team leads to support new hires during their first weeks
  • Track employee datacontract dates, birthdays, leave balances, updates
  • Be the first point of contact for HR-related questions from our remote team
  • Help draft internal communicationspolicies, process guides, updates
  • Keep our digital HR files organized and audit-ready
  • Support offboarding: making sure exits are smooth, respectful, and well-documented
  • Assist with hiring tasks (scheduling interviews, collecting feedback, etc.)
  • Spot gaps in our HR processes and work with us to make them better

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have some background in HR (internship, assistant role, or a degree/cert is great we are not rigid)
  • Understand that HR isn't just about policies its about people
  • Can juggle tasks without needing someone to check in on you every hour
  • Know your way around Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Forms, Calendar)
  • Communicate clearly and professionallywhether by email, Slack, or on a Zoom call
  • Are detail-oriented without being roboticyes, typos matter, but so does tone
  • Know how to handle sensitive info with care and discretion
  • Are curious, humble, and eager to learn how HR really works in the tech world

What You'll Get in Return

  • A real shot to grow into a senior HR leader no waiting years to get noticed
  • Direct access to the leadership team you'll actually be heard
  • Remote-first flexibility work from where you're most productive
  • Paid time off (yes, even in your first year)
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits (for U.S. employees)
  • A team that genuinely respects the value of HR this isn't just a checkbox role

How to Apply

If you're looking for a corporate HR job where you push paper all day this isn't it.

But if you're looking for a real opportunity to build, grow, and be taken seriously in your first HR role, hit that apply button and show us what you're about.

Everglade Works is a people-first company. We believe great ideas and talent come from everywhere, and were committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in.

About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

About the Role:
As an Outbound Enrollment Specialist, you will be responsible for high-volume outbound outreach to eligible program participants and enrolling patients into a high-touch health program supporting their medication adherence and lifestyle changes. This role is key to introducing Scene services to potential patient members for enrollment. The enrollment specialist must excel at connecting with the patient via phone and discovering what patients need through outbound communication. Once patient needs are identified, we rely on the Outbound Enrollment Specialist to guide and direct patients into our services ecosystem. Your role is crucial in establishing trust, motivating patients to commit to their health goals, and ensuring they feel supported every step of the way. You will communicate with patients via phone calls, SMS, and video check-ins to help them overcome barriers and stay engaged in their care.

We’re building a pipeline of commercial underwriters who are ready for their next step. You’ve worked with commercial policies, you understand why commercial risk is different, and you want to keep building on that, with support, structure and real exposure to international markets.

Is this you?

  • You’ve worked hands-on with commercial insurance — even if your title doesn’t say “underwriter”
  • You’re curious, you learn fast and new systems don’t scare you
  • You want an international career without leaving South Africa
  • You feel your skills have outgrown your current role (or your current salary)

What you’ll do

Underwriting & portfolio support

  • Assist with new business, renewals, endorsements and mid-term adjustments
  • Request and assess quotations, present options and implement premium adjustments
  • Help analyse client portfolios and assess risk to ensure appropriate cover and pricing
  • Support retention by keeping renewals on track and reducing policy cancellations

Client & broker communication

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, brokers, insurers and internal teams
  • Build working relationships that support long-term portfolio growth

Administration & compliance

  • Maintain accurate electronic records for audit and compliance
  • Assist with invoicing, refunds and general policy administration
  • Make sure documentation is complete, accurate and up to date

What you’ll need

  • Matric (essential)
  • Hands-on experience with commercial short-term insurance policies
  • Strong written and spoken English, and confidence speaking to clients
  • Comfort with technology and a willingness to learn new platforms quickly
  • South African citizen currently residing in South Africa

Advantageous

  • RE5 / FAIS credits, or working towards them
  • A relevant degree or diploma
  • Experience on broking or underwriting systems

Please note: personal lines experience on its own isn’t suitable for this role. Commercial risk is a different discipline, and our clients need that foundation.

How we work

  • Fully remote from a dedicated home office
  • Fibre internet: minimum 50/50 Mbps, 100/100 Mbps preferred
  • Shifts aligned to UK or Australian business hours. Our clients working hours relate to our 04:00–12:30, 11:00–19:00 and 16:00–00:00 (SAST).

What you get

  • A competitive monthly salary of R20 000 – R29 000, depending on experience
  • A placement working with our clients - established international brokers
  • Onboarding and training into your client’s systems and processes
  • Exposure to UK and Australian commercial markets and modern underwriting practice
  • A clear, transparent recruitment process

How the process works

  • This is a pipeline role. You’ll be considered for current and future opportunities.

  • Typical placement turnaround is 4–8 weeks, depending on client demand.
