raw.excerpt: Athena Developer & Integration AnalystAbout Matter HealthMatter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.
raw.description:
Athena Developer & Integration Analyst

About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.

Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, technically skilled Athena Developer & Integration Analyst to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role will own the development, extension, and integration of our EHR ecosystem, serving as the organization's go-to technical resource on the athenaOne API suite, custom endpoint development, and platform-level configuration.

Our value-based care model depends on a deeply extended, tightly integrated athenaOne platform to support our field-based clinical teams. You will build against athenahealth's 800+ endpoint API surface, architect integrations, and extend what athenaOne can do for our care teams—while also evaluating and introducing AI and agentic tooling that can reduce documentation burden and surface clinical insight for the people doing the work.

This is primarily a software engineering role: writing code against athenahealth's APIs, designing integrations, and extending platform capabilities. Platform administration and configuration are a critical but secondary function, providing senior-level expertise in support of existing administrative capability. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom integrations and extensions on the athenaOne platform using athenahealth's REST and FHIR APIs across Clinicals, Collector, Communicator, and Population Health endpoints

  • Own the full API development lifecycle for athenaOne integrations, including sandbox testing, OAuth 2.0 authentication and token management, endpoint evaluation, versioning, and production rollout

  • Evaluate and prototype AI and agentic tooling within the athenahealth ecosystem—including Marketplace AI-powered solutions and LLM-based workflow automation—to reduce documentation burden and surface clinical insight for field-based care teams

  • Monitor athenahealth API changelogs and release notes, evaluate new endpoints and capabilities as they are released, and manage regression testing and rollout of platform and integration updates

  • Work directly with athenahealth's developer support and partner teams to resolve API issues, request custom endpoints, and pilot new AI-enabled capabilities

  • Design, build, and maintain bidirectional integrations between athenaClinicals and Salesforce, including the middleware, webhooks, and custom API calls that keep both systems in sync

  • Manage authentication, data mapping, transformation logic, and error handling for inbound and outbound data flows—including referrals, care plans, visit data, care team updates, and SDOH data—using REST, HL7, and FHIR-based interfaces as appropriate

  • Partner with clinical leadership to translate workflow needs into athenaClinicals build and configuration, moving fluidly between configuration and code as needed

  • Provide senior-level backup on athenaOne administration, including user roles and provider setup, departments and permission structures, templates, order sets, and quality and HCC risk-capture workflows tailored to a DSNP, dual-eligible population

  • Maintain technical documentation of integration architecture, API usage, data mappings, system configuration, and change history for audit and compliance purposes

  • Troubleshoot API errors, data sync failures, and integration issues across the athenaOne platform and the Salesforce-athenaClinicals integration, serving as the primary internal point of contact for EHR functionality and technical integration questions

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered

  • 3–5 years of experience working with athenahealth products, with the majority in hands-on API development against athenaOne/athenaClinicals REST and FHIR endpoints

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining custom integrations using athenahealth's APIs, including OAuth-based authentication, webhook configuration, and endpoint-level troubleshooting

  • Proficiency with at least one modern programming or scripting language such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or Java for API development

  • Working knowledge of HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 data standards

  • Working familiarity with athenaClinicals configuration and administration, including user and provider setup, templates, and order sets

  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy and security requirements as they apply to system configuration and integrations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical, clinical, and operational teams

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM or care-coordination platform integration

  • Experience with AI or agentic tooling in the athenahealth ecosystem, such as Marketplace AI-powered apps, ambient documentation tools, or LLM-based workflow automation

  • Familiarity with quality measures, HCC and risk adjustment documentation, and special needs plan (DSNP) reporting requirements

  • Experience in home-based care, geriatrics, or value-based care settings

  • Experience in a fast-growing, mission-driven healthcare organization

What Success Looks Like

  • athenaOne integrations are reliable, well-documented, and actively maintained in production with clear ownership

  • The Salesforce-athenaClinicals integration is stable, accurate, and supports seamless care coordination across clinical and operational teams

  • New athenahealth API capabilities and AI-enabled tools are evaluated proactively and piloted where they can meaningfully reduce burden on clinical teams

  • Clinical and operational stakeholders have a trusted, responsive internal resource for EHR functionality and integration questions

  • Integration architecture, API usage, and system configuration are thoroughly documented and audit-ready

  • Platform updates and API changes are managed with minimal disruption to clinical workflows

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

Working at Matter Health

We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date.

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Employer-funded HSA options

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

  • Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage

  • Access to Matter Health's in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match starting on Day 60

  • Financial wellness resources and support

Time Away

  • Up to 4 weeks of PTO

  • 10 paid company holidays

  • 2 volunteer days annually for meaningful causes

Eligibility is based on full-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Matter Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and foster an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are searching for a deep Citrix expert — someone who has lived and breathed Citrix for years, knows the logon process inside and out, and gets genuinely excited about finding the hidden cause of a 30-second login when it should be 8. As our Expert Systems Engineer, you will be the technical anchor of our Citrix Customer Experience team, responsible for the most complex performance investigations, the development of our diagnostic methodology, and the technical mentorship of the broader team.

You will work directly with data, AI-assisted analysis tools, Wireshark traces, Citrix Director deep dives, Power BI dashboards, and your own hard-won expertise to identify — and eliminate — the root causes of poor Citrix logon performance across a large and varied customer base. Your findings will not stay with one customer; you will be the engine that turns individual discoveries into org-wide improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp/XenDesktop), including complex multi-site enterprise deployments, performance tuning, and advanced troubleshooting

  • Expert-level understanding of the Citrix logon process — able to analyze each phase (Session Startup, Brokering, HDX, Authentication, GPO, Profile Load, Interactive Session) and interpret all key VDA and client-side metrics (SSCD, SCCD, NRWD, LPWD, GPVD, PCVD, DMVD, COVD, CAVD, etc.)

  • Deep expertise in Windows Group Policy (GPO) — including design, troubleshooting, and optimization of GPOs in Citrix VDA environments; able to identify settings that impact logon performance and application behavior

  • Proficiency with Citrix Director for in-depth session analysis, logon phase breakdowns, and real-time troubleshooting

  • Experience with Wireshark or equivalent packet capture tools for network-layer logon diagnostics

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to correlate data from multiple sources (Power BI, Logic Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, event logs, Citrix Director) to identify root causes that are not immediately obvious

  • Demonstrated experience documenting complex findings clearly and transforming them into actionable, repeatable processes and runbooks

  • Experience mentoring less senior engineers and elevating the technical capability of a team

Preferred Qualifications

  • FSLogix deep expertise — container configuration, profile management, optimization, and troubleshooting

  • Experience with Azure cloud infrastructure, including Azure-hosted Citrix deployments, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure AD integration

  • Working knowledge of Citrix StoreFront and Workspace App architecture, including configuration best practices and common performance pitfalls

  • Hands-on experience with proxy settings, WPAD, and auto-proxy detection in enterprise environments and their impact on Citrix session behavior

  • Familiarity with Optimus/OptimistDB or similar Windows configuration audit frameworks

  • Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python — able to write or direct automation for GPO auditing, configuration comparison, and data extraction

  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT) in an operational context to analyze configuration data, surface recommendations, and cross-reference knowledge bases at scale

  • Citrix certification at the CCE-V level or equivalent demonstrated expertise

  • Healthcare IT or managed services experience — particularly environments running Allscripts/Altera applications (Sunrise, Paragon, TouchWorks, Denali) — is highly desirable

  • Exposure to double-hop Citrix architectures and associated performance implications

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Logon Performance Analysis & Diagnostics

  • Lead the most complex and ambiguous Citrix logon performance investigations, going beyond surface metrics to identify true root causes across all logon phases: HDX/Session Creation (SCCD), Brokering (NRWD, LPWD), Authentication (CAVD, COVD), GPO Processing (GPVD), Profile Load (PCVD), Drive Mapping (DMVD), and Interactive Session

  • Perform deep-dive analysis of customer logon data — comparing high-performing and low-performing environments, drilling into subnet-level variations, user-level inconsistencies, and machine-specific outliers to isolate contributing variables

  • Conduct packet-level analysis using Wireshark to identify network-layer contributors to logon delays — including DNS resolution timeouts, drive mapping failures, proxy/WPAD misbehavior, and ICA session establishment delays

  • Analyze Azure Log Analytics for error patterns (e.g., 4908 errors, drive mapping failures) and correlate with logon timeline data to build a complete causal picture

  • Interpret and act on data from Citrix Director, Logic Monitor, Power BI (Citrix All dashboard, GPO dashboard, scatter plots), and other data sources to identify systemic patterns not visible to less experienced engineers

  • Leverage AI tools to ingest large volumes of Citrix configuration data, policy exports, and knowledge articles, extracting actionable recommendations and cross-referencing against current customer environments

GPO Analysis & Best Practice Engineering

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on GPO configuration for Citrix VDA environments — including CTX VDA Configuration settings (SeamlessFlags, LogoffCheckSysModules, USERProcessHandleQuota, and others), Citrix session policies, Windows Component settings (IE, File Explorer, Remote Desktop Services), and security/audit configurations

  • Identify GPO misconfigurations, overlapping policies, legacy drift, and missing best-practice settings across the customer base, with particular focus on settings that directly impact logon time

  • Develop and maintain the GPO best practice library and Citrix policy standards that serve as the reference for all customer environments — including both Azure-hosted and Sunrise/on-premises environments

  • Investigate and resolve complex proxy/WPAD/auto-proxy configuration issues through GPOs and their downstream impact on session and application performance

  • Review Optimus reports and other automated audit outputs for Citrix and Windows server configuration gaps (IAS app pools, SSRS standards, network configurations) and drive remediation

Profile Management & Session Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize Citrix user profile configurations — including FSLogix container settings, mandatory profiles, local profile management, and profile size bloat — to reduce profile load times (PCVD) across the customer base

  • Evaluate and tune HDX policy settings for performance — including EDT protocol behavior, virtual channel configurations, and session reliability settings — with a focus on reducing Session Creation Client Duration (SCCD)

  • Investigate Double Hop scenarios and identify registry-level remediation (e.g., SlowHPCPolling) and architectural improvements to reduce CPU overhead and HDX latency

  • Assess StoreFront vs. Citrix Workspace App usage across customers and recommend architectural improvements to reduce brokering and session startup times

Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer

  • Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way

  • Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing

  • Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned" — specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base

  • Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time

  • Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling

  • Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale

  • Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments

  • Work with internal tooling teams (e.g., Ashish/team) to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines

What Success Looks Like

Within 60 days, you have completed a formal assessment of logon performance across the highest-priority customers, produced a ranked list of root causes with specific remediation recommendations, and delivered the first iteration of the team's diagnostic playbook. Within 6 months, multiple customers have measurably improved logon times directly attributable to your analysis and the team's execution, at least two systemic improvements have been propagated across the full install base, and the Systems Engineers on your team are noticeably more capable diagnosticians than when you arrived.

Our mission is to make quantum computing practical and impactful by bridging the gap between hardware and real-world applications. Our platform enables developers and enterprises to design, optimize, and deploy quantum algorithms at scale, automating complex processes and supporting teams from beginners to experts across diverse architectures.

Clasiq is trusted by Fortune 500 leaders and global governments. We accelerate the quantum era with a platform that transforms bold quantum ideas into working applications.

As a Quantum Solutions Architect, you'll lead the technical track of the sales cycle in the Americas (government, enterprise, academy), helping customers with varying capabilities in the quantum software domain to evaluate, adopt, and engage with Classiq's quantum software platform. You’ll partner with all the GTM teams and serve as the trusted advisor for customers and team members, finding solutions to the most complex challenges, guiding technical discovery, and delivering customized demos that fulfill the customers’ expectations.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Sales and other teams to qualify, scope, and shape opportunities, and then, with the customers, define technical engagement plans and strategy
  • Lead technical discovery processes to understand customer challenges across a variety of domains (such as Finance, Pharma, Automotive, Healthcare, logistics, and many more) using quantum information and quantum algorithm development expertise.
  • Build trust and lead customers to educated decisions through clear, compelling demos
  • Articulate complex quantum computing concepts to a range of technical audiences, one-to-one and one-to-many
  • Proactively identify new technical opportunities within customer conversations
  • Influence product direction by relaying field feedback from prospects
  • Maintain a library of reusable implementation assets and POC templates

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Presale Engineer, or deep DevOps roles that were customer-facing), or in a strategic technical position with strong cross-functional engagement (e.g., Product Manager, System Architect)
  • A degree with Computer Science and compelling experience in deep tech, or a degree in quantum information or quantum computing - preferred. A Ph.D. is preferred in a relevant field.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly
  • Experience with quantum information, quantum software engineering, or quantum algorithms
  • Located in the US and a native English speaker.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bonus: Industry experience in Machine Learning and AI

Why Join Us

  • Advance national security innovation through quantum computing.
  • Work with world-class researchers and engineers.
  • Competitive compensation: base, commission, equity.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly environment.
  • Shape quantum adoption in the US Federal landscape.

Role Overview

As a Salesforce Technical Architect for the Platform Team at Cabin, you will serve as a trusted technical leader and strategic advisor, playing a pivotal role in the architecture, strategy, and successful delivery of enterprise software solutions. Bridging the gap between complex business needs and robust technical implementations, you will lead the solution design across Salesforce multi-cloud platforms. In this high-impact role, you will drive technical excellence, establish platform governance, design enterprise integrations, and mentor engineering peers to bring strategic vision to life from discovery through execution.

Why Cabin?

At Cabin, we are more than just a digital innovation firm—we are a dynamic, boutique consultancy where creativity and collaboration thrive. Specializing in digital product discovery, design, and delivery, we work with clients across industries to bring groundbreaking ideas to life. As a company, we embrace a culture of deep focus, high-impact problem solving, and long-term partnerships, fostering an environment where innovation and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.

The name 'Cabin' reflects the essence of our work philosophy. Like a cabin in the woods, our space is a sanctuary for thoughtful reflection, creativity, and growth. Here, we remove the distractions of the outside world to focus on what truly matters—creating exceptional products that drive business success. Just as a cabin brings people together in a quiet, welcoming environment, we bring together talented professionals to collaborate, innovate, and achieve extraordinary results. At Cabin, you’re not just part of a team; you’re part of a community where your ideas are valued, your expertise is elevated, and your career can flourish.

Joining Cabin means taking on high-impact, high-visibility digital initiatives while working alongside a diverse, talented team of strategists, designers, and developers. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of digital products, drive transformative change for our clients, and influence the product lifecycle from strategy through execution.

If you’re ready to contribute to meaningful work, drive digital transformation, and bring strategic vision to life, Cabin is the place for you.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Technical Strategy: Own the architecture and technical strategy of assigned platform solutions, ensuring Salesforce multi-cloud environments (Sales, Service, Experience, Data Cloud) are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with client business objectives.
  • Enterprise Systems Integration: Design and oversee integration architectures connecting Salesforce with back-end enterprise systems, data warehouses, and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft), employing REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, and large data volume strategies.
  • Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Communicate directly with client stakeholders and executive leaders to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical solutions, architectural roadmaps, and requirements.
  • Governance & Quality Assurance: Define and enforce development standards, data governance, security protocols, and platform limit management, balancing short-term delivery goals with long-term technical health.
  • DevOps & Release Management: Establish and advocate for modern release practices, scratch org strategies, automated CI/CD pipelines, and version control tooling tailored to Salesforce (e.g., Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset).
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Represent platform engineering in cross-functional discussions with product strategists, experience designers, and client leadership, advocating for technical capabilities and strategic alignment.
  • Risk Management & Design Reviews: Proactively identify architectural risks, surface platform blockers, and conduct thorough technical design and code reviews to maintain quality, security, and scalability across deliverables.
  • Mentorship & Team Enablement: Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, setting high standards for technical excellence, guiding work delegation, and fostering continuous learning and career growth across the engineering team.

Qualifications

  • Proven Technical Delivery Leadership: 8+ years of experience in software architecture and software engineering, with a proven track record of leading technical delivery for complex enterprise platforms from inception through deployment.
  • Extensive Salesforce Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Salesforce solutions, with deep expertise in declarative platform capabilities, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and multi-cloud architectures.
  • Salesforce Certifications: Active Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) are highly preferred.
  • Integration Architecture: Demonstrated capability to architect complex integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise systems using middleware, event-driven architectures, APIs, and identity/SSO frameworks.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, business owners, and C-suite executives.
  • Consultancy & Client Engagement: Experience working within a consultancy or professional services environment, demonstrating the ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced client settings.
  • Modern Engineering & DevOps Practices: Strong proficiency with Salesforce DX, automated testing, Git, and modern CI/CD release pipelines.
  • Mentorship & Team Development: A strong track record of mentoring engineers, fostering team growth, and leading through influence and technical craftsmanship.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent professional technical experience.

Job Description

Senior Network Architect | HM- Ashish Pawar

Your Day at Altera Digital Health

The Senior Network Architect is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.

This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.

The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Location: Pune, India – Remote
Experience: 15–18+ Years
Certification:CCIE – Mandatory

What You'll Be Doing

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments.
  • Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
  • Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
  • Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
  • Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long-term technology and business goals.
  • Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.
  • Ensure project objectives are achieved, resources are allocated effectively, and project milestones are delivered successfully.
  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders to ensure network solutions align with overall business strategies.
  • Serve as a senior-level subject matter expert and provide technical guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to network engineering and operations teams.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with network vendors, service providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Evaluate vendor offerings and technical solutions and provide recommendations aligned with organizational requirements.
  • Lead efforts to optimize network performance by analyzing traffic patterns, implementing appropriate QoS strategies, improving network resiliency, and enhancing availability.
  • Stay current with emerging networking technologies, industry trends, and technology developments and assess their applicability to the organization.
  • Develop and maintain high-level network documentation, including architecture diagrams, HLD/LLD documents, configuration templates, standards, and technical guidelines.
  • Perform network capacity planning to accommodate anticipated business growth and evolving technology requirements.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Lead architecture reviews and ensure network designs comply with established enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices.
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network architecture, performance, and connectivity issues.

Knowledge and Attributes

  • Extensive understanding of advanced networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
  • Extensive proficiency in designing, configuring, and managing complex network environments, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, SD-WAN, and cloud networking technologies.
  • Extensive knowledge of advanced network protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, SD-WAN, QoS, IPv4/IPv6, and advanced security protocols.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise LAN, WAN, Data Center, Internet, and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud networking.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
  • Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
  • Proven experience leading and managing large-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
  • Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Active CCIE certification is mandatory.
  • Preferred CCIE specializations include:
    • CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
    • CCIE Service Provider
    • CCIE Security
  • Relevant cloud certifications such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud are preferred.
  • Additional networking or security certifications are an advantage.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 15–18+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.
  • Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
  • Extensive experience working in large-scale enterprise networking environments.
  • Extensive experience designing and architecting complex LAN and WAN environments.
  • Extensive experience with network security and enterprise security architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Data Center networking and connectivity.
  • Extensive experience with cloud networking, including Azure and/or AWS.
  • Extensive experience with SD-WAN and software-defined networking (SDN) concepts.
  • Proven experience with network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Proven experience working with network vendors, ISPs, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and architectural direction to engineering and operations teams.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 15–18+ years of relevant Network and Security experience.
  • Active CCIE certification – Mandatory.
  • Strong enterprise network architecture and design experience.
  • Expert-level Cisco networking experience.
  • Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, and Data Center networking.
  • Strong experience with network security technologies.
  • Strong experience with cloud and hybrid network architectures.
  • Proven experience leading complex network projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

raw.description:
The Manager of Treasury is responsible for overseeing the organization's daily cash management activities, short- and medium-term liquidity forecasting, banking relationships and account structures, and cash reconciliation processes. This role is instrumental in maintaining adequate liquidity to support business operations, maximizing returns on excess cash, and minimizing financing and borrowing costs.

The position also leads treasury-related process optimization initiatives, leveraging NetSuite, the company's ERP platform, to enhance efficiency, strengthen internal controls, improve cash visibility, and support strategic financial decision-making. The Manager of Treasury collaborates closely with Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to ensure effective cash flow management and alignment with organizational financial objectives.

Must be able to work the East Coast hours of Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm comfortably.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Daily Cash Management

  • Manage and monitor daily cash activity across all operating and disbursement accounts

  • Ensure cash is positioned in the correct bank accounts to meet operational needs and minimize idle balances

  • Execute daily/weekly transfers between accounts as needed, including funding of disbursement accounts

  • Support wire and ACH payment processing, including dual-approval controls

Cash Forecasting

  • Prepare and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, updated daily

  • Analyze variances between forecasted and actual cash flows and adjust assumptions accordingly

  • Forecast cash receipts and disbursements using AR/AP aging reports, historical trends, and knowledge of customer payment behavior and vendor payment terms

  • Identify and clearly flag when borrowing or debt repayment will be needed based on projected cash position

  • Partner with FP&A on liquidity assumptions for annual budget and long-range planning

Bank Structure & Reconciliation

  • Assist in the design and implementation of a concentration account and zero balance account (ZBA) structure

  • Perform or oversee reconciliation of all bank accounts (approximately 15 accounts), ensuring timely resolution of discrepancies

  • Maintain relationships with banking partners and serve as a point of contact for day-to-day banking issues

Investment & Yield Optimization

  • Research and recommend short-term investment vehicles (money market funds, sweep accounts, overnight investments, CDs, etc.) to maximize earnings on excess cash

  • Monitor market rates and banking fee structures to ensure competitive terms

Debt & Credit Facility Management

  • Manage debt covenant compliance monitoring

Internal Controls & Governance

  • Maintain and enforce treasury-related internal controls (segregation of duties, approval hierarchies, fraud prevention/positive pay)

  • Maintain treasury policies and procedures documentation

  • Support audit requests (internal and external) related to cash and bank activity

Systems & Reporting

  • Lead ongoing optimization of NetSuite treasury functions (cash management module, bank feeds, reconciliation automation) to drive efficiency and process improvement

  • Prepare monthly treasury reporting package for senior leadership

  • Evaluate and recommend treasury workstation or cash management technology tools.

The above duties are meant to be representative of the position and not all-inclusive.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field.

  • 5–10 years of progressive experience in treasury, cash management, or corporate finance.

  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-account bank structures and daily cash positioning.

  • Experience building and maintaining rolling cash flow forecasts (13-week or similar).

  • Strong understanding of AR/AP aging and its application to cash forecasting.

  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

  • High attention to detail and comfort working under deadline pressure.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Experience with NetSuite (or willingness/aptitude to learn quickly).

  • Experience with JPMorgan Access (or comparable bank platform) for reporting, wires, and account management.

  • Experience setting up or optimizing concentration/ZBA account structures.

  • Prior experience in a multi-entity or multi-bank environment.

  • Experience optimizing or configuring NetSuite (or similar ERP) treasury/cash management functionality post-implementation.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Location of job activities 100% inside

  • Extensive manual dexterity (keyboarding, mouse, phone)

  • Use of phone for communication

  • Sit for prolonged periods of time.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The expected base pay range for this position is $100,000-130,000 per year. The actual compensation for the position may vary based on market differences and on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications and can vary based on location and/or work schedule. In addition to base pay, CareTria offers a comprehensive benefits package. Full-Time benefits include access to health, dental, and vision insurance; retirement plan options; paid time off; paid parental leave; employee assistance programs; and other perks. Eligible employees may also have access to performance bonuses.

We are looking for a Remote Data Operation Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess strong abilities in order and organization, with a keen attention to detail. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to our organization's data management and ensure accuracy and efficiency.

What does the day-to-day look like in this role?

The day-to-day in this role combines operational and analytical work around data and campaigns.

As part of the role, you will work closely with Campaign Managers, pull data from various systems, create daily and weekly Excel reports, perform data checks and cross-referencing within large datasets, and ensure that the data is accurate, accessible, and clearly presented to support decision-making.

In addition, the role includes presenting data to Campaign Managers and Team Leads in the Media Department, as well as identifying anomalies or gaps in the data. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys working with numbers, Excel, and data, pays strong attention to detail, stays organized and accurate, and can respond quickly to needs that come up in the day-to-day work.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience in data entry and data operations within the online marketing industry.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads and Meta/Facebook) and common campaign metrics such as Spend, CPC, CTR, and CPA
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data-related issues.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines consistently.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Technical survey: Strong computer proficiency, including advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to leverage them to improve productivity and efficiency
  • Bachelor's degree in an analytical field.

Responsibilities

  • Enter and maintain accurate data into our systems with a high level of precision and attention to detail.
  • Organize and sort incoming data, ensuring it is categorized correctly for easy retrieval.
  • Conduct regular data quality checks to identify and correct any errors or inconsistencies.
  • Assist in data analysis and reporting, generating reports and summaries as required.

raw.description:
About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

Adherence Coach

Job Overview

As an Adherence Coach, you play a key role in delivering video-based patient engagement and medication adherence support as part of Scene’s digital care model. Acting as an extension of the clinical nursing team, you serve as a patient connector and support partner who engages patients through asynchronous video interactions, personalized video feedback, and digital messaging to reinforce consistent medication-taking behaviors and support positive health outcomes.

In this role, you will review patient medication videos submitted through Scene’s proprietary adherence platform and respond with motivational, supportive video-based coaching to guide patients through their treatment journey. You will help patients overcome barriers related to medication adherence and social determinants of health while connecting them to appropriate resources and services.

Your goal is to build trust and accountability through engaging video communication, encourage ongoing program participation, and empower patients to take an active role in managing their health.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, metrics-driven, adaptable in a fast-moving environment, and comfortable communicating through video-first digital health tools. This is a high-accountability role requiring strong communication skills, an outgoing personality, and comfort working toward measurable performance targets.

This is a full-time role with day and late-day shifts.

Anticipated shifts include:

8:00 AM - 4:00 PM, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, or 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST

*Estimated to have at least one Saturday shift per month.

Key Responsibilities

1. Video-Based Patient Engagement & Adherence Support

  • Review assigned asynchronous patient medication videos within established turnaround times and document adherence accurately per program protocol.
  • Confirm proper oral medication ingestion and identify barriers to adherence
  • Deliver personalized video feedback and coaching to reinforce correct medication-taking behaviors and provide encouragement.
  • Use video messaging, phone, and SMS to support ongoing patient engagement and adherence.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to patients who miss submissions or show declining adherence.
  • Support re-engagement efforts for patients at risk of attrition.
  • Maintain professional, video-forward, high-quality digital communication aligned with engagement standards.

2. Care Coordination & Support

  • Serve as a frontline support partner to the RN team to ensure timely patient follow-up and connection to appropriate services.
  • Reinforce adherence to care plans and medication schedules through video-based education and digital coaching.
  • Facilitate appointment adherence by reinforcing the importance of physician visits and identifying barriers to attendance.
  • Screen for and document social determinants of health (e.g., transportation, housing instability, food insecurity, financial barriers).
  • Provide approved community and program resources to address identified social needs.
  • Reinforce clinical care plans established by licensed staff (without modifying plans).

3. Escalation & Clinical Partnership

  • Promptly escalate medication questions, side effects, safety concerns, or health issues to nursing staff per protocol.
  • Identify behavioral, social, or adherence risks and escalate as appropriate.
  • Support safe care delivery by maintaining strict adherence to the scope of practice.

4. Technical & Operational Support

  • Assist patients with basic troubleshooting for the mobile application, the adherence platform, and program information.
  • Maintain accurate, compliant documentation of all patient interactions.
  • Meet quality, compliance, and performance standards for review accuracy and video-based patient engagement metrics.
  • Participate in quality audits, team meetings, and ongoing professional development.
  • Contribute feedback to improve video engagement strategies, patient experience, and adherence workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in healthcare engagement, care coordination, adherence support, or similar role.
  • Experience interacting directly with patients in healthcare settings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Comfort reviewing patient-submitted video content.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and mobile applications.
  • Strong time management skills in a queue-based workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background as a medical assistant, pharmacy technician, community health worker, certified health coach, or directly observed therapy worker.
  • Experience in digital health or remote patient monitoring.
  • Experience working with Medicaid or underserved populations.
  • Bilingual (Spanish preferred)
  • Familiarity with motivational interviewing principles.

Key Metrics

  • Minimum of 80 videos reviewed per 8-hour shift
  • >80% of engagement via video
  • Exceed engagement standards via quality checks
  • Meet the quarterly departmental goal for patient retention
  • 100% of escalations meet protocol standards

Scope of Practice

This role does not provide medical advice, modify care plans, or make clinical decisions. All clinical questions, medication adjustments, and health concerns must be escalated to licensed pharmacists or nursing staff per protocol.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work remotely while making a tangible impact on patients' lives
  • Be part of an innovative healthcare solution addressing a $500B medication adherence challenge
  • Collaborate with passionate professionals across healthcare, technology, and public health sectors
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling company

The biggest perk is that you will be working on a game-changing solution in healthcare with people who are talented, motivated, and passionate. Scene has impacted thousands of lives to date, but you will be integral in scaling that impact.

If you are a compassionate, tech-savvy nurse with a passion for patient engagement and medication adherence, we want to hear from you! Apply today to join us in transforming healthcare and empowering patients toward better health outcomes.

**Candidates must reside in Puerto Rico and maintain Puerto Rico residency throughout employment. Must be legally authorized to work in Puerto Rico/United States without employer sponsorship; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We believe in reflecting the diversity of our customers and their patients in our team. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Scene is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental ability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

______

Descripción General del Puesto

Como Adherence Coach (Coach de Adherencia), desempeñarás un papel clave en brindar apoyo a los pacientes mediante interacciones por video y en promover la adherencia a los medicamentos como parte del modelo de atención digital de Scene. Como extensión del equipo clínico de enfermería, servirás como enlace y recurso de apoyo para los pacientes, interactuando con ellos a través de videos asincrónicos, respuestas personalizadas en video y mensajes digitales para reforzar hábitos consistentes en la toma de medicamentos y contribuir a resultados positivos de salud.

En este puesto, revisarás los videos de los pacientes tomando sus medicamentos, enviados a través de la plataforma de adherencia de Scene, y responderás mediante videos personalizados que brinden motivación, orientación y apoyo durante su tratamiento. Ayudarás a los pacientes a superar barreras relacionadas con la adherencia a sus medicamentos y con los determinantes sociales de la salud, conectándolos con los recursos y servicios apropiados.

Tu objetivo será desarrollar una relación de confianza y responsabilidad con los pacientes mediante una comunicación dinámica y efectiva por video, fomentar su participación continua en el programa y empoderarlos para que asuman un papel activo en el manejo de su salud.

La persona ideal para este puesto presta gran atención a los detalles, se siente cómoda trabajando con métricas y objetivos medibles, se adapta fácilmente a un entorno de trabajo dinámico y se comunica con confianza utilizando herramientas digitales de salud donde el video es el principal medio de interacción. Este es un puesto con un alto nivel de responsabilidad que requiere excelentes destrezas de comunicación, una personalidad extrovertida y comodidad trabajando para alcanzar objetivos de desempeño medibles.

Este es un puesto a tiempo completo con turnos durante el día y al final de la tarde.

Los turnos previstos incluyen:

  • 8:00 a. m. – 4:00 p. m., 9:00 a. m. – 5:00 p. m., 10:00 a. m. – 6:00 p. m. y 11:00 a. m. – 7:00 p. m., hora del Este (EST).
  • Se estima que el puesto requerirá trabajar al menos un sábado al mes.

Responsabilidades Principales

1. Interacción con Pacientes por Video y Apoyo con la Adherencia

  • Revisar los videos asincrónicos asignados en los que los pacientes toman sus medicamentos, dentro de los tiempos establecidos, y documentar con precisión la adherencia de acuerdo con los protocolos del programa.
  • Confirmar la administración correcta de medicamentos orales e identificar posibles barreras para la adherencia.
  • Proporcionar respuestas y orientación personalizadas por video para reforzar la toma correcta y consistente de los medicamentos, además de brindar motivación y apoyo.
  • Utilizar mensajes por video, llamadas telefónicas y SMS para fomentar la participación continua del paciente y la adherencia a sus medicamentos.
  • Realizar acercamientos proactivos a pacientes que no envíen sus videos o que muestren una disminución en su adherencia.
  • Apoyar los esfuerzos para volver a involucrar a pacientes que estén en riesgo de abandonar el programa.
  • Mantener una comunicación digital profesional, de alta calidad y centrada en el uso de video, de acuerdo con los estándares de interacción establecidos.

2. Coordinación de Atención y Apoyo

  • Servir como recurso de apoyo de primera línea para el equipo de enfermería (RN), asegurando el seguimiento oportuno de los pacientes y su conexión con los servicios apropiados.
  • Reforzar la adherencia a los planes de cuidado y horarios de medicamentos mediante educación por video y orientación digital.
  • Promover la asistencia a citas médicas, reforzando la importancia de las visitas al médico e identificando posibles barreras que dificulten la asistencia.
  • Identificar y documentar determinantes sociales de la salud, como dificultades de transportación, inestabilidad de vivienda, inseguridad alimentaria o barreras económicas.
  • Proporcionar recursos comunitarios y del programa previamente aprobados para atender las necesidades sociales identificadas.
  • Reforzar los planes de cuidado clínico establecidos por profesionales de la salud con licencia, sin modificar dichos planes.

3. Escalamiento y Colaboración con el Equipo Clínico

  • Escalar de manera oportuna al personal de enfermería cualquier pregunta relacionada con medicamentos, efectos secundarios, preocupaciones de seguridad o problemas de salud, de acuerdo con los protocolos establecidos.
  • Identificar riesgos relacionados con el comportamiento, las circunstancias sociales o la adherencia del paciente y escalarlos según corresponda.
  • Contribuir a una atención segura mediante el cumplimiento estricto de los límites y responsabilidades establecidos para el puesto.

4. Apoyo Técnico y Operacional

  • Ayudar a los pacientes a resolver problemas técnicos básicos relacionados con la aplicación móvil, la plataforma de adherencia y la información del programa.
  • Mantener documentación precisa y conforme con los requisitos aplicables de todas las interacciones con los pacientes.
  • Cumplir con los estándares de calidad, cumplimiento y desempeño relacionados con la precisión de las revisiones y las métricas de interacción con pacientes mediante video.
  • Participar en auditorías de calidad, reuniones de equipo y actividades continuas de desarrollo profesional.
  • Proporcionar recomendaciones y comentarios que contribuyan a mejorar las estrategias de interacción por video, la experiencia del paciente y los procesos de adherencia.

Requisitos

  • De 3 a 5 años de experiencia en interacción con pacientes en el área de salud, coordinación de atención, apoyo con la adherencia o un puesto similar.
  • Experiencia interactuando directamente con pacientes en entornos de atención médica.
  • Excelentes destrezas de comunicación oral y escrita.
  • Excepcional atención a los detalles.
  • Comodidad revisando contenido en video enviado por pacientes.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente en un entorno remoto.
  • Dominio de sistemas CRM y aplicaciones móviles.
  • Excelentes destrezas de manejo del tiempo en un flujo de trabajo basado en colas de tareas.

Cualificaciones Preferidas

  • Experiencia o formación como asistente médico, técnico de farmacia, trabajador comunitario de salud, coach de salud certificado o trabajador de terapia directamente observada (DOT).
  • Experiencia en salud digital o monitoreo remoto de pacientes.
  • Experiencia trabajando con poblaciones de Medicaid o comunidades con acceso limitado a servicios.
  • Bilingüe, preferiblemente español.
  • Conocimiento de los principios de la entrevista motivacional.

Métricas Clave de Desempeño

  • Revisar un mínimo de 80 videos por cada turno de 8 horas.
  • Mantener más del 80 % de las interacciones con pacientes mediante video.
  • Superar los estándares de interacción establecidos mediante evaluaciones de calidad.
  • Cumplir con la meta trimestral del departamento relacionada con la retención de pacientes.
  • Garantizar que el 100 % de los escalamientos cumplan con los protocolos establecidos.

Alcance de la Práctica

Este puesto no proporciona asesoramiento médico, no modifica planes de cuidado ni toma decisiones clínicas. Todas las preguntas clínicas, ajustes de medicamentos y preocupaciones relacionadas con la salud deben ser escaladas a farmacéuticos o personal de enfermería con licencia, de acuerdo con los protocolos establecidos.

Beneficios y Ventajas

  • Salario competitivo y paquete de beneficios.
  • Oportunidad de trabajar de manera remota mientras generas un impacto tangible en la vida de los pacientes.
  • Ser parte de una solución innovadora de atención médica que aborda un desafío de aproximadamente $500 mil millones relacionado con la falta de adherencia a los medicamentos.
  • Colaborar con profesionales apasionados de los sectores de atención médica, tecnología y salud pública.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento dentro de una compañía en rápida expansión.

La mayor ventaja es que tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en una solución que está transformando la atención médica junto a personas talentosas, motivadas y apasionadas. Scene ya ha impactado la vida de miles de personas, y tú serás una parte fundamental para ampliar ese impacto.

Si eres una persona compasiva, con facilidad para utilizar la tecnología y pasión por la interacción con pacientes y la adherencia a los medicamentos, ¡queremos conocerte! Solicita hoy para unirte a Scene y ayudarnos a transformar la atención médica y empoderar a los pacientes para lograr mejores resultados de salud.

Los candidatos deben residir en Puerto Rico y mantener su residencia en Puerto Rico durante todo el período de empleo. Deben estar legalmente autorizados para trabajar en Puerto Rico/Estados Unidos sin necesidad de patrocinio por parte del empleador. No se ofrece patrocinio de visa para este puesto.

raw.description:
Altera, a member of the N. Harris Computer Corporation family, delivers health IT solutions that support caregivers around the world. These include the Sunrise™, Paragon®, Altera TouchWorks®, Altera Opal, STAR™, HealthQuest™ and dbMotion™ solutions. At the intersection of technology and the human experience, Altera Digital Health is driving a new era of healthcare, in which innovation and expertise can elevate care delivery and inspire healthier communities across the globe. A new age in healthcare technology has just begun.

Job Title: Sr Implementation Consultant Core/ Ambulatory

Location:Remote - Canada

Sunrise™ | Altera Digital Health

OVERVIEW

As a Sr Implementation Consultant on our Professional Services team, you will be a key contributor to the digital transformation of healthcare across Manitoba. This role is central to successfully rolling out our Electronic Medical Records (EMR) to various ambulatory clinics and healthcare institutions across the province.

You will be trained to deploy numerous Altera applications, with a primary focus on the Sunrise EMR Core and Ambulatory functionalities, including related products such as DBmotion, CPM, Opal, and Patient Portal. In addition, you will provide expert workflow consulting services by following a structured methodology through all phases of the implementation life cycle. Your efforts will directly ensure the successful and seamless implementation and utilization of our solutions, moving clinics from paper-based to fully electronic platforms.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the full suite of Altera software solutions, with emphasis on our Sunrise EMR (Core and Ambulatory), at our client sites, primarily in Manitoba.
  • Perform all project workplan tasks in accordance with contracted project scope, functioning as a vital member of a larger project team (including PMs, Solution Architects, Clinical Consultants, and CMIOs).
  • Perform complex system configuration tasks, including providing high-level consultation and technical guidance on system configuration to clients.
  • Provide expert workflow consultation and guidance to clients on critical ambulatory processes, including registration, scheduling, and clinical documentation. You will be responsible for translating existing paper-based clinic workflows into an optimized electronic format.
  • Proactively identify, resolve, and/or escalate system and complex workflow issues that arise throughout your implementation project.
  • Provide comprehensive activation support; consistently meet or exceed client utilization and transformation targets.
  • Set appropriate expectations with various client stakeholders, from end-users to executive leadership (e.g., CMIOs), and expertly manage them throughout the project life cycle.
  • Anticipate client needs, function as a client advocate, and demonstrate exceptional stakeholder engagement skills to foster successful project delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS

Academic and Professional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience required.

Work Experience

  • 2+ years of hands-on healthcare IT implementation and configuration experience
  • Strong, demonstrated functional knowledge of an EMR/EHR system
  • Specific expertise in Altera Sunrise EMR (Core or Ambulatory) is preferred. Experience with Epic or Meditech is also valued if coupled with deep knowledge of essential clinic workflows (e.g., registration, scheduling, clinical documentation).
  • Must have experience working as part of a formal implementation project team that has successfully rolled out EMR systems.
  • Clinical background preferred (SME who has rolled out clinics).
  • Technical background, i.e. background in SQL or SSRS reporting preferred.
  • Proven client presentation experience; strong written and oral communication skill set, with the ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders (technical resources to executive leadership).
  • Project management experience; skilled at managing numerous key priorities simultaneously during a long-term (e.g., 12-month) implementation cycle.
  • History of taking on roles, tasks, and projects where quickly learning new information is required; a "quick study."

TRAVEL

10-15% travel. Travel is primarily to provide critical on-site support during final go-live activities.

WORK ARRANGEMENTS

  • Remote role. Candidates may reside anywhere in Canada but must be willing and able to travel as required.

Our company complies with all local/state regulations in regard to displaying salary ranges. If required, the salary range(s) are displayed below and are specifically for those potential hires who will perform work in or reside in the location(s) listed, if selected for the role. Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data, ranges, applicant's skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications (e.g. JD, technology), for example.

 

Salary Range

$ 65,000 - $ 75,000 CAD. The salary range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education

 

 

Altera is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local law.
